articleTitle: Impact of the Statistical Properties the Input Data for Mathematical Models in a Digital Twin Environment
abstract: The paper deals with the problem of evaluating the statistical properties of the input data in Automated Process Control Systems when used in simulation and digital twin environment. In modern real-time digital systems mathematical methods have been used increasingly to generate hybrid models of control systems, one of which problems is the compatibility of input data. We have studied the statistical properties of the digital system input data flow in the digital twin environment of the control system in order to determine the possibility of describing the specified data using standard distributions. Studies were conducted both at the level of individual packets and for averaged data. As a result, it is shown that a description of the input data properties using standard distributions is possible when averaging network packets over about seconds. The results can be used to generate mathematical models of real-time digital systems.

articleTitle: Neural Network Technology for Technical Assessment States of Power Transformers
abstract: This article describes the development and testing of a methodology for creating an artificial neural network for assessing the technical condition of power transformers and its application to improve the efficiency of a hydroelectric power station. Based on the analysis of scientific and technical documentation, a sample was developed with scores for each parameter of the power transformer components. The developed technique based on an artificial neural network was tested using the example of finding the most significant parameters of a power transformer. It has been established that the results of neural network modeling are fully consistent with the operational results. The prospects of using neural network technologies to assess the technical condition of power transformers are shown.

articleTitle: Analysis of Signal Integrity and Distortion in Twisted Pair in a Multilayer Printed Circuit Board
abstract: One of the areas of information security of electronic systems is the physical protection of information. Includes techniques for maintaining the integrity of electrical information signals in electronic systems at the physical level and reducing electromagnetic emissions. Differential transmission of electrical signals is one of the most promising areas for building high-speed electronic systems from the point of view of physical information protection. To transmit such signals on printed circuit boards, a differential pair are used - two transmission lines with a strong coupling between them. In practice today, each line is a conventional coplanar, stripline, or microstrip transmission line. This article discusses a new type of communication lines on printed circuit boards in the form of twisted pairs. Structurally, the twisted pair is implemented in two layers of a multilayer printed circuit board using vias. The article analyzes distortions of information signals in connections of multilayer printed circuit boards in the form of twisted pairs. The results are compared with the distortion of information signals in coplanar interconnects.

articleTitle: Research of Signal Adaptive Filtering Algorithms
abstract: The article aims to research the existing signal adaptive filtering algorithms. The task of filtering signals from noise and distortion is an important scientific and technical problem. In this paper, white noise filtering using an adaptive filter is considered. Classical adaptive filtering algorithms have been chosen to solve the problem. The efficiency of the least mean squares and the recursive least squares with forgetting factor algorithms was compared for the white noise filtering tasks. As a result of this work, it turned out to filter a multiharmonic signal from the white noise using the least mean squares and the recursive least squares with forgetting factor algorithms.

articleTitle: The Effect of Changing-Lane Prediction Algorithms on the Performance of ACC System Model in Matlab/Simulink
abstract: Self-driving vehicles are capturing the attention of numerous researchers, companies, and car enthusiasts. The automation of vehicles varies across multiple levels, depending on the tasks they perform and the techniques they employ. The Adaptive Cruise Control (ACC) system is an automated vehicle at the first level. It checks the presence of other vehicles in its lane to adapt its velocity accordingly or maintain a constant speed. However, it does not include lane-changing capabilities. Nevertheless, the presence of other neighboring vehicles can affect the performance of the ACC based Model Predictive Controller (MPC) system, leading to discomfort or collisions. In this paper, we will provide a brief description of the ACC system and the MPC controller. Subsequently, we will discuss the challenges that affect the performance of the ACC based MPC system and propose potential solutions using the Variable Time Headway (VTH) strategy or changing-lane prediction algorithms, such as Random Forest (RF), K- Nearest Neighbor (KNN) and Support Vector Machine (SVM). Simulation results of applying these methods to a sufficiently dangerous driving scenario will be illustrated, followed by a brief conclusion.

articleTitle: Development of an Information System for Modeling and Visualization of Crops Growth and Development under Climate Change Conditions Using 3D Modeling and VR/AR Technologies
abstract: The article discusses the main aspects of simulation and visualization of agricultural crops under conditions of climate change caused by the greenhouse effect using 3D, VR/AR technologies. A bank of 3D models of 37 agricultural crops has been provided that allows to visualize the development of plants at all stages of growth depending on various combinations of external parameters that determine the result of plant development. The use of the introduced information system makes it possible to conduct crop simulation with visualization of the growth and development stages while varying the maximum possible number of parameters. It provides the ability to assess, predict and select the optimal environment for increasing productivity. The purpose of the research is the implementation of the introduced information system in the crop production and in a number of other areas. The digital transformation of crop production is a part of the federal strategy aimed at adapting agricultural areas to climate change and obtaining consistently high yields through the introduction of Industry 4.0 technologies and platform solutions. The article describes a prototype of a toolkit that allows to modernize the decision-making process during sowing by taking into account the influence of the greenhouse gases in the ground layer of the atmosphere on the photosynthetic activity of agricultural plants.

Author Keywords: gradual growth and development of agricultural crops

articleTitle: Conceptual Model of Complex Integrated Systems
abstract: The article deals with the design of complex systems. The article describes the current state and evolution of information system design and creation processes. The main approaches to the design of complex systems based on classical and systematic approaches are considered. An approach to system design based on the theory of dynamic chaos is described. Based on the results of the analysis of existing approaches to the design of complex integrated systems, the need to develop new models and methods for the design of complex integrated systems is justified. A model of complex and integrated systems based on fuzzy set theory is proposed. The main parameters of the model are defined. A method for constructing a set of connections of a complex integrated system based on graph theory is proposed.

articleTitle: Contactless Control System is a Dimensional Device for Monitoring Rolling Stock in the Process of their Movement
abstract: In this article, it is possible to control the gabarite of the content in motion on railway tracks on the basis of a non-contact microprocessor gabarite control device, determine the reliability of the device's operation, as well as transfer data from a non-contact gabarite control device with a microprocessor to microprocessor centralization in a wireless network medium. The contactless gabarite control device is based on microprocessor elements with software. Auxiliary blocks in it at the same time serve to ensure the safety of movement and control the gabarite of the content in motion. Control of gabarite using contactless technologies is the acquisition and use of information from infrared sensors and electromagnetic path sensors, which has reduced the cost of operating the system without control wires and increased economic efficiency.

articleTitle: System of Oil Express Flow Control on the Basis of Proton Magnetic Resonance Relaxometry
abstract: Today oil industry actively turns towards the modernization of equipment and industrial technologies. New oil-mining equipment, methods of diagnosis and raw materials processing are being dynamically developed for implementing smart digital oil deposits (SDOD). One of the relevant problems is providing a reliable control of the water-oil liquids' condition without which none of the oil-wells will meet the demands of SDOD. To solve this problem, the authors of the paper have designed flow oil analyzer on the basis of proton magnetic resonance relaxation (PMRR). This device gives the opportunity to conduct the express-control and analysis without probe preparation. The data by this method is received from correlations between oil properties and PMRR-parameters quickly involving the verification of data using different PMRR-parameters. The paper provided the methods developed for of the flow express-control, its implementation and theoretical substantiation of the system.

articleTitle: Unsupervised Production Machinery Data Labeling Method Based on Natural Language Processing
abstract: This paper proposes an approach for the unsupervised labeling of production machinery data with the leverage of Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques. Acquiring labeled data for training machine learning models poses a significant challenge involving high monetary and time costs, which can be tremendously reduced using the method presented in this paper. The method, described in this paper, uses standard NLP techniques in combination with vector representations of dataset object descriptions, obtained using a pre-trained transformed-based model, to automate the dataset markup. The proposed method was evaluated on a real-world production machinery dataset and demonstrated its effectiveness in assigning meaningful labels in a natural language to dataset records. Implications of this work can be extended to any sector, having classes and descriptions of dataset objects in a natural language.

articleTitle: Stability Increasing of Rolling Mills Electric Drives in Case of Voltage Sags by Using Static VAR Compensator
abstract: The article presents the results of research aimed at ensuring the stable operation of rolling mills electric drives in conditions of frequent occurrence of external voltage sags. The high sensitivity of frequency converters (FC) with active rectifiers (AR) to the asymmetry of the supply voltage is an operation's specificity of this electric drives. This fact can lead to a FC-AR system's shutdown due to current inrush exceeding the protection response settings and a decrease in the voltage level in the DC- link. A review of existing ways to solve this problem showed the following: modern voltage sags damping methods in-plant grids, aimed at improving the stability of the electric drives of rolling mills, envisage the control systems modernization for active rectifiers or the usage of external energy storage devices. In some cases, the possibilities of such measures are limited, especially with deep voltage sags (more than 20%). Thus, the paper presents a new approach to solving the issues of compensation of voltage sags in the in-plant grids of compact metallurgical plants. This approach is based on the usage of available reactive power reserves of static var compensators (SVCs) operating in combination with electric arc furnaces (EAFs).

articleTitle: Neural Network Model for Constructing Feedback in Nonlinear Control Systems Based on Asymptotic Methods and the SDRE Approach
abstract: Here the problem of nonlinear control system stabilization is considered. By presenting the model of a nonlinear control system with a parameter that changes over a certain interval in a formally linear form with state dependent matrices and by introducing a quadratic quality criterion the SDRE approach is applied. Then a neural network model is built to determine a suboptimal controller based on the use of asymptotic and Padé approximations of the matrix Riccati equation solution. It is based on the procedure for selecting the best approximation option and methods for the improvement of the obtained solution (for example, splines) and takes into account the specifics of problem classes.

articleTitle: A Model of the Robotic Assembly Process Based on a Force-Moment Sensor
abstract: Nowadays, although a great number of methods for the robotic assembly of cylindrical joints are known, most of them are based on the assumption that the shaft and the hole are well aligned before mating. In practice, if there is a misalignment of the position of the shaft and sleeve, parts jamming may occur. This article proposes an assembly robot control algorithm that controls the execution of high-precision joints based on the identification of the output signals of the force-torque sensor. An experimental setup with an ABB IRB-140 industrial robot is used to evaluate the effectiveness of the algorithm for assembling the shaft in sleeve with gaps of 0.01 mm, and 0.05 mm. During the experiments, the reduction of the assembly force was up to 3 times or more, and the assembly success rate was 100%. The experimental results show that the assembly strategy can successfully complete the precision peg-in-hole assembly and assist the robot in accurate assembly in industrial applications.

articleTitle: Development of a Digital Twin of an Autonomous Underwater Vehicle to Assess the Effectiveness of Searching for Bottom Objects
abstract: The problem of developing a digital twin of an autonomous underwater vehicle is being solved to assess the effectiveness of its functioning when searching for bottom objects. The factors on which the effectiveness of searching in a given area depends are analyzed, and the processes that need to be reproduced using simulation modeling are identified. It has been determined that the effectiveness of searching for objects depends on the size of the area, the performance of the search determined by the width of the inspection swath, the physical principles of detection means, the bottom topography, and the state of the marine environment. When using the method of statistical tests (Monte Carlo method) to evaluate the effectiveness in each test, simultaneously with the movement of the autonomous underwater vehicle, the following are reproduced: the movement of detection means, characterized by sectors of view, the sequential selection of detection means for searching, determined by the control system of the vehicle depending on environmental conditions and the degree of identification of classification characteristics of the search object.

articleTitle: Utilizing Cloud Technologies in the Investigation of Physicochemical Processes
abstract: This article is dedicated to describing the fundamental organizational structure of an information system designed to address the challenges of empirical research on complex physicochemical processes using cloud technologies. The intricate nature of such processes necessitates the adoption of non-trivial approaches to organizing computational tasks. The use of cloud technologies in modeling complex processes is becoming increasingly relevant with the substantial growth in computational power and the advancement of modern software development tools. The paper presents a description of a three-tier network architecture and justifies the choice of solutions used at each stage of development. To ensure uninterrupted calculation management in a multi-user access mode, the principle of contactless inter-network interaction is employed. The execution of all proprietary developments in a remote environment is organized using Docker containerization technology. Furthermore, the developed information system supports the integration of new programs and computational modules from external developers.

articleTitle: On the Smart Card Data Privacy in Public Transport
abstract: Information technologies are becoming more widespread every year. Solutions based on data analysis are also developing in the urban transport management field. One of the most popular modern sources of personal mobility data is data from transport system validators. In our article, we present a method for finding the smart card identifier of a public transport system user at several spatio-temporal points based on data from validators. In the future, this identifier can be used by attackers to track the user. We analyze the influence of the number and nature of spatio-temporal points and the accuracy of timing on the success of the attack. We pay attention not only to the aspects of using such data for possible user tracking but also propose a system architecture for recovering lost travel documents based on our method.

articleTitle: Computer Vision Methods for Assessing Ovarian Reserve
abstract: The ovarian reserve reflects a woman's ability to successfully realize her reproductive function. The assessment of the ovarian reserve is an actual task for clinical practice. The use of methods of computer processing of diagnostic images, which can speed up and facilitate the performance of routine tasks, increase the objectivity of clinical ultrasound diagnostics, allows for a retrospective analysis. The paper considers the application of machine learning methods for the analysis of ultrasound images. In this paper, we propose the use of modern methods of deep learning in the task of segmentation. Creating special augmentations with the transformation of objects in an ultrasound image. The correct methodology for dividing data into training and validation for use in the medical field. And we also made our dataset publicly available, which contains complex examples from real ultrasound.

articleTitle: Applying Real-Time Whale Optimization Algorithm for Environmental Quality Monitoring System in Hai Phong Port, Vietnam
abstract: Air pollution is a top concern in major cities of developing countries. Air Quality Monitoring systems with impressive operational procedures in domestic premises are key to the creation of a sustainable pollution free green port In this article, the authors propose to build an air environment monitoring system at seaports in Vietnam based on LoRaWAnwireless communication technology. The system includes sensors that collect parameters such as CO, SO2, NO2, and PM2.5 at each intermediate station. Use the Real-time Data Transfer algorithms (RT_DTWOA) to optimize the transmission and reception process and calculate the AQI index. Experimental results of the system are stable, cost-effective and accurate on maps at the monitoring center.

articleTitle: VR Simulator for Operational Switching in Closed Switchgears of 35-220 kV Substations
abstract: This paper describes the relevance of the development and implementation of a virtual simulator for operational switching in a closed distribution device. Special attention is paid to the development of a 3D model, since a realistic model of the object will allow students to get as close as possible to a real energy facility. The need to immerse students in different environments will significantly increase their involvement in the learning process and allow them to work out actions in non-standard situations. An important point is the possibility of demounting any element of the CRU cell. Users have the opportunity to have an accurate perception of various objects in a virtual environment, which is useful for improving the actual level of work of trainees, improving the quality of training and efficiency, and reducing training costs. Algorithms are given that describe the procedure of actions in the electrical installation and the rules for using this VR simulator. The introduction of the simulator in the preparation of specialists will have a positive impact on the level of training of future specialists and their adaptation to the conditions of existing production facilities.

articleTitle: Adaptive Control System for the Process of Sorting Objects Using a Robotic Arm
abstract: The paper describes the implementation of a software-hardware complex that implements the sorting of objects by colour using computer vision. The algorithm for determining the working area of the robot-manipulator is given. The control action on the executive mechanism is formed by an algorithm implemented in Python using the C3 Bridge Interface, OpenShowvar and OpenCV software libraries for interaction with the robot and computer vision. A Kuka KR4 6-axis industrial robot manipulator with pneumatic gripper is used as an actuator that performs direct object movement. The developed hardware and software system can serve as a basis for creating flexible robotised manufacturers.

articleTitle: The Analysis of the Neural Network Optimizers in Condition of the Limited Dataset
abstract: Training the neural networks on an ever-smaller amount of data is getting more relevant today. Especially the business is being involved into the tending to spend less computing resources, at the same time reducing the development time of the final product. In this case it is evident that the end user would get the product for less cost in a shorter time. The solution is relatively complex and affects several aspects of neural network architecture development at the same time. One of the key elements of neural network training is the weighting factor optimizer. In this paper the behavior of four popular neural network optimizers - stochastic gradient descent (SGD), root-mean-square propagation (RMSProp), adaptive moment estimation (Adam) and decoupled weight decay regularization (AdamW) were studied for the limited size of training dataset. Each of the optimization methods is described and analyzed in details. As a neural network, a residual neural network (ResNet) architecture has been developed for classifying as many as ten classes. Stochastic gradient descent algorithm turned out to be the best optimizer in terms of accuracy. Root-mean-square propagation algorithm appeared to be the best optimizer related to the loss function. The results of the study are illustrated by graphs of neural network loss functions. The results of this research could be used while training the neural networks with a limited or no access to big data sets.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Approaches for Failures Detection in Inertial Navigation Systems
abstract: Inertial Navigation Systems (INS) are essential for the navigation of both surface and underwater crafts, playing a critical role particularly in autonomous and automated control systems. The reliability of these systems is paramount for ensuring the safe maneuvering of such vessels. Monitoring the technical condition of INS is crucial for operational safety. However, traditional diagnostic approaches often fall short in effectively tackling INS challenges due to dynamic uncertainties, external interferences, and susceptibility to informational disruptions. This paper presents a comparative study on the application of various machine learning strategies for diagnosing failures in INS. It specifically examines gyroscope and accelerometer data from surface vessels, employing the Nomoto model to describe their dynamics. The paper suggests methods for feature engineering and evaluation of their significance. Multiple machine learning algorithms were developed, refined, and evaluated to address the diagnostic challenge. An analysis comparing the effectiveness of these models is also included.

articleTitle: On the Issue of Continuous Monitoring of Oil Well Production Parameters
abstract: The article considers the problem of continuous control of technological parameters for effective management of oil fields while reducing material and economic costs. A measuring complex has been developed for continuous control of the main parameters of oil well production (water content and fluid flow rate) directly inside the tubing string. The method of real time monitoring of water-oil mixture flow parameters is based on the indirect method of determining the characteristics of the medium flowing through the upper section of tubing string by means of two methods: dielectric permeability control of the medium with a capacitive sensor and density control of the medium with a differential manometer. The results of conversion of measurements of percentage of water in the water-oil mixture were used in algorithms for obtaining values of moisture content and velocity of medium movement. As a result of researches it has been revealed that the developed measuring complex possesses acceptable accuracy of measurements of volumetric liquid flow rate. The use of algorithms for obtaining values of moisture content and velocity of medium movement provides the required accuracy and speed of obtaining measurement results required for practical application.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Adaptive Control of UAV Flight Under the Influence of Wind Disturbances
abstract: s─The article examines the problem of controlling the flight of an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) when exposed to external disturbances. A justification for the choice of a mathematical model of UAV movement, as well as a disturbance model, is given. To adequately describe the UAV flight, a mathematical model of the longitudinal movement of the aircraft in a trajectory coordinate system was chosen. Piecewise constant disturbances, which are the worst disturbances acting on the control object, are adopted as a model of external influences. A procedure for synthesizing an autopilot for controlling a UAV in a turbulent air environment is presented. For the synthesis, the synergetic method of analytical design of aggregated regulators - ADAR - was used. Two variants of adaptive control laws have been synthesized: an astatic controller that compensates for external unmeasured disturbances; as well as a dynamic controller with an asymptotic observer of external disturbance. In the course of modeling the resulting closed systems “control object - autopilot law” in the presence of external influence, the performance of both variants of regulators was shown.

articleTitle: Hyper-Parameter Selection of Machine Learning Models for Predicting the State of a Technical Object
abstract: To decrease emergency response time in the operation process of a technical object, a timely response to its functional failure is necessary. Hence, there is a problem of predicting the state of a technical object and possible violations during its operation based on the results of studying the parameter set for object operation. Machine learning methods can be used to solve this problem. The article also considers random forest and support vector machine as machine learning models. However, a machine learning model depends on hyper-parameters that must be tuned before the training process, for the model to function correctly and maintain high accuracy in predicting the object state. The paper discusses three methods for hyper-parameter selection: grid search, random search and Bayesian optimization. The authors evaluated a hydraulic valve to study the effectiveness of methods for selecting hyper-parameters of machine learning models for predicting the state of a technical object.

articleTitle: Trust Model for Active Scanning Methods, Ensuring Their Secure Interaction with Automated Process Control Networks
abstract: Active network scanning methods are increasingly used in modern intrusion detection systems (IDS) to collect and analyze circulating traffic in the network of an automated process control system (APCS). Despite the legitimacy of the active scanning process, it may turn out to be unsafe for the stability of the ICS network, since it requires a formalized response from the network equipment. Production processes are typically continuous, so network scanning is carried out in real time, and disruption of equipment due to failure is unacceptable. In this regard, the development of safe methods for active scanning of networks is relevant. The work formulates a trust model for active scanning methods based on a number of conditions, ensuring their secure interaction with automated process control networks. The model includes 3 trust conditions that must be met to ensure safe scanning. The operation of the model was tested on a laboratory bench operating under the control of programmable logic controllers of the Siemens and KEAZ families. During the experiments, three characteristics were statistically assessed: the volume of excess traffic, the accuracy of constructing the network topology, and the proportion of correct node responses, reflecting the fulfillment of trust conditions for the studied active scanning methods. Based on the results of the experiments, conclusions were drawn about the effectiveness of the model.

articleTitle: Reducing the Percentage of Defective Castings Using the Neural Network Modeling Method
abstract: The article is devoted to the current problem of reducing the percentage of defective products manufactured at serial steelmaking plants. To study the patterns of defect formation, a neural network was created that predicts the formation of defects such as “Cracks” in castings produced by the open-hearth method. To train the neural network, statistical data taken under the conditions of the current production process was used, which resulted in a high degree of information noise. Outliers of statistical information were detected and removed with the original author's neural network technique. By conducting virtual computer experiments on a neural network model, some important dependences of the probability of the defect formation on the content of manganese, phosphorus, silicon, chromium, and sulfur were identified. Based on that, practical recommendations have been developed to reduce defects by adjusting the chemical composition of the metal. Despite the relatively low accuracy of the created neural network model, the application of the practical recommendations made it possible to reduce the percentage of defective products manufactured at a serial plant by half.

articleTitle: Ensuring the Integrity and Availability of Information in the Model of Decentralized Data Storage System
abstract: A model of decentralized data storage system is presented to ensure the integrity and availability of information based on decentralized management algorithm. The proposed decentralized management algorithm solves the problem of a rapidly growing IP address table due to the increasing number of system users. We propose an approach focused on optimizing the direct links between the hosts of the storage network and dynamically calculating their ratings. Host ratings are calculated based on network latency, uptime, and processor performance. The rating calculation is a two-stage process, the second stage takes CPU performance into account. This model offers a tiered structure of masterhosts, where first-level masterhosts accumulate host IP addresses and provide access to their database, maintaining the current state of the decentralized storage network, second-level masterhosts aggregate the IP addresses of first-level masterhosts into groups, thus creating a hierarchical network structure. The paper evaluates the proposed approach by calculating the consumed service traffic required to maintain each host, and compares the decentralized storage scheme and the centralized scheme. The results show that the decentralized system is superior to the centralized one in terms of data availability and has a higher efficiency of disk space utilization due to savings on data duplication, which proves the possibility of effective existence of such a system, and thus its application to ensure the integrity and availability of stored data.

articleTitle: CAD Architecture for Expansion of WSL-Based Combinational Circuits Dataset
abstract: The paper provides an overview of the current state of research in the field of combinational circuits reliability and parameters. Architecture of OpenLane flow, its components and main stages of work are described. Based on this flow, the main parameters are provided that will be used for augmentation and expansion of combinational circuits dataset and further testing. Previously developed software was elaborated to use OpenLane as its part. That is, now WSL (Ubuntu) can be used to launch OpenLane workflow from a Windows program without copying data from/to Linux system; subsequent parsing of the results to highlight the necessary parameters is implemented; parameters are saved to combinational circuits dataset. The modified software was tested for circuit generation and parameters calculation.

articleTitle: Processing of Nonlinear Heterogeneous Data in Information and Control Systems
abstract: The article presents a method for cluster analysis of heterogeneous data using the provisions of fuzzy logic. Heterogeneous are data of various formats and collected from various sources. In addition, such data is usually incomplete and inaccurate, which makes it difficult to process and cluster them. The article presents mathematical models for representing a candidate for a vacant position, which is characterized by heterogeneous data. The apparatus of algebraic systems was used to develop mathematical models. A method for determining the membership function of fuzzy sets using a probabilistic approach, as the most effective when working with heterogeneous data, is described in detail. An example of the formation of a base of logical rules for the formation and selection of classification features in a set of heterogeneous data of the personnel reserve of a manufacturing enterprise is given. The selected classification features allow for further accurate and efficient verification and evaluation of information about candidates for a vacant position. In addition, the proposed method of cluster analysis of heterogeneous data can be applied in various subject areas that involve the use of incomplete and inaccurate data, for example, socio-economic, technical, biological systems.

articleTitle: Automated System Application for the Production of Metallurgical Products for Analysis of Technological and Logistic Processes
abstract: The results of using an automated system for the production of metallurgical products (AS PMP) to solve problems of analysis and optimization of in-plant logistics processes are presented. The logistics processes under study are formalized by a model of resource transformation processes implemented in the modeling subsystem. A feature of these processes is the presence of bottlenecks associated with the occurrence of conflicts on shared resources and facilities. A hybrid method for analyzing and eliminating bottlenecks is proposed, implemented in an automated system for the production of metallurgical products in order to support the optimization of the processes under study. As a result of applying the hybrid method to the problem of optimizing the logistics processes of an oxygen converter shop, practical recommendations were obtained on the formation of intervals for supplying melts to the shop's converters in order to prevent downtime of continuous casting machines.

articleTitle: Mask Correction in 3-D Tomography Brain Images for Weakly Supervised Segmentation of Acute Ischemic Stroke
abstract: In this paper we propose a method for weakly supervised segmentation of 3-D computed tomography brain images of acute ischemic stroke using convolutional neural nets. To improve the segmentation quality of stroke areas, the concepts of a distance map and weight map are introduced. The maps are utilized to correct the predictions of the model at the boundaries of the affected areas. Additionally, a smoothing method is introduced for segmentation masks to reduce labeling defects. The study uses two sets of data: the primary set that includes labeling made by a single radiologist, and the auxiliary set of smaller size with several variants of labeling made by different radiologists. The latter set is analyzed to reveal the basic characteristics of labeling discrepancies which arise due to complex nature of analyzed images. The 3D U-Net model is employed for the primary set segmentation. DICE loss and Focal loss are used to train the model, and DICE score is utilized to evaluate the quality of forecasts. The results of experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Development and Analysis of Genetic Algorithm for Optimization of Continuous Cast Billets Warehousing Process
abstract: Warehouses are an important logistic component of various companies. Warehouses may have different layouts, equipment and their own features. Optimization of warehouse operations can decrease overhead costs and increase the economic efficiency of industry. The technological process of steel sheet production at a metallurgical company includes two major stages: casting of liquid steel into billets and rolling of these billets on a rolling mill. In order to coordinate the productivity of these two stages and to be able to fulfill orders promptly, a warehouse of slabs (billets) is used. Billets of different parties and steel grades are stored in stacks. The billets are moved to the warehouse for storage and from the warehouse to the rolling mill by bridge cranes. In this paper the problem of optimization of the process of continuous cast billets storage is solved to minimize the number of slab handling operations. The problem is decomposed into two subproblems SLAP (Storage Location Assignment Problem) and CSP (Crane Scheduling Problem). A modified genetic algorithm was applied to solve the problem. Using a simulation model of the warehouse, the efficiency of the algorithm was evaluated using different approaches to take the restrictions imposed on the process of slab handling into account. It is shown that the most effective is the algorithm in which there is no restriction on the placement of stacks of billets belonging to one melting._

articleTitle: Dynamic Load Balancing and Distribution Algorithm in Distributed Cloud Computing
abstract: This article proposes an algorithm for dynamic load distribution and balancing in distributed cloud computing. A mathematical model and algorithm of a two-level load management system for virtual clusters of a data center have been developed. At the first management level, virtual machines (VMs) are assigned to physical servers. At the same time, a greedy algorithm is used with time restrictions in searching for acceptable load distribution alternatives. The second level of management is implemented considering the chaotic structure of network traffic between the data center and users. Checking for the chaotic nature of a time series of information traffic is conducted using the Lyapunov exponents. The predictive model of the load intensity is implemented using the method of phase space reconstruction based on a set of values of a one-dimensional time series. When building a reconstructed phase space attractor, the time delay value is selected from the condition of reaching the zero value of the autocorrelation function, and the dimension of the embedding is determined by the angle of inclination of the straight line approximating the dependence of the value of the correlation integral on the radius of a given threshold point. The Tayler window is used to exclude correlated points in the numerical series. The criterion for evaluating the effectiveness of the developed algorithm is an integral indicator of the deviation of the load of each server from a given level.

Author Keywords: autoregressive model load distribution and balancing

articleTitle: Maintenance of Operable Condition of a Flexible Production System Through the Development and Implementation of a Method for Cutting Tools and Workpieces Operational Control
abstract: The objective of this research is to maintain the operational state of a flexible manufacturing system (FMS) within the required timeframe by developing and implementing a method for operational control of cutting tools and processed workpieces. A reliable technological system (TS) for the mechanical processing operation is to maintain the production of parts with the required quality and quantity within the specified time, particularly crucial when considering FMSs that eliminate personnel to constantly monitor the technological operation. Through the conducted analytical review, the relevance and immediacy of the work aimed at developing the method for operational control of cutting tools and workpieces are emphasized. This method involves the autonomous operation of the TS through multisensory integration of data on changes in geometric parameters of cutting tools and workpieces, with programming automation and management of information about cutting tools using a database of cutting and auxiliary tool parameters. Within the scope of the research, an experimental validation of the proposed method was conducted, along with solutions addressing issues related to predicting the technical condition of cutting tools for enterprises in the instrument-making and machinery industries under actual production conditions. The prediction of the technical condition of cutting tools was performed using artificial intelligence (AI) methods. The proposed approach for obtaining initial data for developing predictive models is characterized by its reliability, minimizing erroneous results from technical diagnostic and control systems operating independently.

articleTitle: A Speed Prediction Model Using A HIL Simulator and Neural Network for Cargo Ships
abstract: This paper introduces the research and construction of a speed prediction model for ships using an artificial neural network and a hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) simulator. The proposed model is an MLP feedforward neural network training based on the back-propagation algorithm. Instead of using historical data such as from the AIS identification system, noon report data, or directional wave spectrum data, this study uses a dataset generated from a HIL simulator, with the plant model being a dynamical model of the real ship. In particular, the 3D dynamic model is built based on the 6-degree-of-freedom (6-DOF) equations of the ship, mathematical models of environmental disturbances, and the propulsion system. The testing results show that the proposed model works reliably and accurately with the testing dataset. The model can be applied to find optimal routes for cargo ships to improve fuel efficiency.

articleTitle: Image Classification Task Automation Using Neural Networks
abstract: The task of pattern recognition with subsequent classification of the obtained images is considered. The relevance of the topic is determined by the increasing need for automation of pattern recognition processes using advanced technologies such as neural networks, which will significantly improve accuracy and efficiency in solving scientific and production tasks in any sphere of economy. Factors are named, tools and architectures that should be considered when building neural networks are listed, as the speed of code writing and quality of functioning depend on it. It is suggested to use TensorFlow, Keras as deep learning frameworks for implementation. The paper focuses on testing and evaluating the quality of neural network training using various metrics. The paper touches upon the problem of overtraining of neural networks and lists classical ways to prevent overtraining, with emphasis on adding a regularisation layer Dropout. An example of application development using artificial intelligence technologies is given. This kind of applications will automate and greatly facilitate the task of product quality control, reducing image classification time, increasing productivity.

articleTitle: Development and Application of Incomplete Digital Twins for Studying Processes in Ferrofluid Sealer
abstract: Ferrofluid (FF) is a colloidal solution of magnetic particles with a surfactant in a carrier fluid. Ferrofluid sealers (FF sealers) ensures tightness of moving shafts with zero leakage of the sealed medium and high reliability. The technology of FF sealing of rotating shafts is a promising area of application for FF. The development of new devices based on FF and expanding the scope of their implementation are complex and pressing scientific tasks. Conducting research requires the development of special test benches and experimental techniques. The use of modern software systems to create models and verify data is a promising area of research. The digital twin of the magnetic circuit was developed for conducting experiments on the test bench, used to calculate the value of magnetic induction in the working gap. The obtained dependencies are used to recalculate the values of magnetic induction in the measuring gap into the value of magnetic induction in the working gap of the FF sealer. The digital twin of the thermal circuit for FF sealer was developed to verify measurement methods and obtain data on the temperature distribution in the FF volume. Energy dissipation in the FF causes an increase in temperature and a decrease in viscosity, which affects the resistance provided by the FF sealer to the drive motor. Incomplete digital twins can be used to solve problems without creating complex models that are complete twins. Developing methodology for carrying out measurements using digital twins is an urgent scientific problem.

articleTitle: Priority Service in Data Transmission Networks with Non-Stationary Flows
abstract: The subject of research. Analysis of the impact of priority data transmission in high-load multi-channel systems represented as a mass service system with request prioritization under different variations in the distribution of random variables of packet arrival intensity in the network and service time in the channels. Method. The study of the influence of priorities on the efficiency of data transmission in multi-channel systems was carried out using simulation and mathematical statistics methods. Main results. The method of numerical calculation of time parameters based on the simulation model of multi-channel data transmission system with heterogeneous load is proposed. Simulation experiments evaluating the impact of priority data transmission at different coefficients of variation of packet intensity and service time in the channels on the time characteristics of the multi-channel system are conducted. Practical significance. The obtained results can be applied to the design of multi-channel computer systems of high load data transmission, providing the optimal use of priorities to improve the efficiency of data transmission.

articleTitle: Investigation of a Novel Architecture for a One-Way Ranging UWB Local Navigation System
abstract: Ultra-Wide Band (UWB) technology is the most promising for indoor positioning and navigation tasks among existing radio systems. Widely used one-way ranging UWB local navigation systems (LNS) architectures do not allow the consumer to receive coordinates on board, but only on the LNS infrastructure side. In this regard, it is relevant to develop such LNS architecture, which allows the consumer to solve the navigation problem onboard, but at the same time to have a quality of work comparable to the known UWB LNS. The aim of the work is to develop the UWB LNS architecture that meets the given requirements, as well as the experimental study of the obtained characteristics. The obtained results show that the standard deviation of time difference of arrival (TDoA) estimation errors does not depend on the lag value and is at the level of 6–8 cm, which corresponds to typical values provided by UWB technology in one-way ranging architectures. The growth of the TDoA systematic error estimation is caused by the instability of the reference oscillators of the devices leading to the drift of the timescale. The errors of navigation determinations in dynamics have comparable values with the known variants of TDoA UWB LNS.

articleTitle: Maintaining a Wireless Sensor Network Structure in a Variable Dynamic Environment
abstract: This article discusses a wireless sensor network, in which elements are attached to a group of robots located on the surface of the water. Due to the group being exposed by constant and unpredictable environmental influences such as wind, waves and swell, the structure of the wireless sensor network can be disrupted to complete failure. Because of this, there is a need to synthesize a control algorithm that could support a predetermined structure of a wireless sensor network on the surface of the water. The proposed algorithm is quite simple to implement, is distinguished by its flexibility and allows to accurately specify the desired shape of the network structure in advance.

articleTitle: Analysis the Informative Value of Digital Images of Signals from Industrial Control Systems Under the Influence of Cyberattacks
abstract: The focus of this article is on the information content of a digital image of an observed time signal from an industrial control system (ICS) that is affected by cyberattacks. The process of creating a digital image of the observed signal involves three stages: obtaining a time-frequency image of the signal, performing two-dimensional digital filtering of the time-frequency image, and selecting the most informative components of the image. An analysis of process behaviour and detection of anomalies in ICS processes, which may occur during cyberattacks, is conducted using machine learning technologies and deep neural networks applied to the digital image of the observed ICS signal. The research identifies anomalies in observed ICS processes by analyzing both the signals and time-frequency images of the ICS signals. The article shows that detecting anomalies from time-frequency images of ICS signals produces better results than detecting anomalies directly from the ICS signals. This text highlights the informative nature of digital time-frequency images of ICS signals in detecting anomalies caused by cyberattacks.

articleTitle: Production Experience Storage Systems as an Element of Intelligent Decision-Making Support
abstract: This paper examines the modern approach to the storage and use of production experience as a set of retrospective data which characterizes the functioning of a production system at a certain historical period. It focuses on the differences between intelligent information systems and traditional transactional systems. Additionally, the main characteristics of intelligent information systems created with data warehouse technologies, operational analytical data processing, and data analysis are briefly described. Lastly, the paper discusses the task of creating an information storage from the point of view of its application in the general concept of total industrial automation.

articleTitle: Validation of Moment Monitoring Results in Rolling Mill Stand Spindles
abstract: The authors highlight the need for the development and industrial deployment of online monitoring systems for the elastic moment on the rolling mill stand spindles. An example of a 5000 plate mill was used to demonstrate that these systems are made due to the need for a reliable moment assessment in dynamic modes. This problem is relevant for the development of control systems limiting the maximum (amplitude) values of moments when the workpieces enter the stand. The shock loading causes a multifold increase of the dynamic moment over the steady rolling moment. This results in the fatigue breakdown of spindle connections., as well as mill failures and emergency stops. The authors provide information on a telemetric elastic moment monitoring system installed on a 5000 mill. The data were validated in the industrial context. To achieve this, the authors propose a procedure where experimental research is carried out in two stages. During the first stage, the electromagnetic moment of the motor is compared to the spindle moment in the quasi-steady rolling mode when the elastic properties of the spindle are not manifested. During the second stage, the elastic moments of the upper and lower roll motors are assessed during 9 passes of reverse rolling. Some conclusions are made about the proportion of roll motor loads, spindle moment amplitudes, and the relevance of aligning rolling moments through the improvement of electric drive speed control algorithms.

articleTitle: Augmented Reality Using for the Obstacles Avoidance Route Planning by an Autonomous Underwater Vehicle
abstract: The problem of forming a route for a large autonomous uninhabited underwater vehicle for laying cables on the seabed is considered. Due to the uneven topography of the seabed, there are areas where the cable can sag and develop premature defects. To avoid laying the cable in such dangerous zones, the operator who forms the route for the device considers them as obstacles and creates the shortest route bypassing these zones. Due to the large discreteness of existing bathymetric maps, it was necessary to reduce it. For this purpose, the Kriging method was used in the work, and fuzzy probabilistic analysis was used to identify zones. The results of the research made it possible to create an augmented reality graphical interface for the operator developing a route for laying cables on the seabed. Based on the results of the formation of dangerous zones in the form of obstacles, the shortest route to avoid obstacles was determined using Dijkstra's algorithm, which ensures minimization of the device's energy consumption in comparison with movement on other routes. On the digital map, it became possible to display the position of dangerous zones and the shortest route against the background of the seabed surface topography, as well as the ability to “play” the developed shortest route in a 3D image.

articleTitle: Skeletal Animation of Three-Dimensional Models Using Nanite Technology
abstract: Nanite technology is a cutting-edge innovation that revolutionizes detail rendering by enabling pixel-level and real-time processing of vast amounts of geometry. The paper delves into the advantages of Nanite in enhancing the creation of highly intricate and lifelike 3D models. It also explores how this technology transforms the conventional methods of developing 3D models while highlighting certain limitations, such as the absence of support for skeletal animation. Moreover, the study proposes a potential solution to address this limitation, presenting a well-rounded perspective on both the capabilities and constraints of Nanite technology. The research further discusses the promising prospects for advancing studies in this field, indicating a direction for future development and exploration.

articleTitle: Using a Decision Tree for the Clustering Problem
abstract: Clustering of datasets with mixed type data: quantitative and categorical is difficult by classical methods of cluster analysis. The study proposes to solve the problem of clustering multivariate data using a decision tree. This method requires setting the number of clusters, limiting the maximum proportion of observations that fall into each cluster, and also requires setting a target variable. The latter requirement can be fulfilled by an expert method or by experimenting with different target variables. The method was tested on the data of advertisements about residential real estate for sale in St. Petersburg. At first, tree clustering method was tested on the dataset with only quantitative data, then on the dataset with mixed types of data: quantitative and categorical. The results were compared with the results of the hierarchical method with different distance metrics. The proposed method does not require data standardization, has a higher speed of operation than hierarchical clustering and shows a clearer interpretation of the clustering results.

articleTitle: Positioning Welding Robot Link at a Fixed Equipment Angle
abstract: This paper deals with the construction of a general mathematical model of a three-axis fixed-point welding robot. The purpose of the model is to determine the optimal parameters for welding operations, taking into account the forces and moments in the robot links. First, the fulcrum is determined, which will serve as the basis for the model. Then the angles between the robot links are determined, which influence the maximum values of the moments and forces. Based on the data obtained, the maximum values of the moments are determined as a function of the robot position and the workpiece diameter. This makes it possible to determine what maximum diameter of the workpiece can be used to perform welding operations in each specific robot position. Thus, the proposed mathematical model makes it possible to evaluate the capabilities of a three-axis welding robot and determine its optimal parameters for performing various welding tasks.

articleTitle: The Using of Artificial Neural Networks for Reinforced Concrete Structures Condition Monitoring
abstract: The paper considers the problem of defect detection on concrete products using convolutional neural networks. The analyzed dataset is considered and the structure of the YOLO model is described, and comparative metrics for different processes are obtained. Performance metrics of neural network algorithms are plotted and examples of test image processing are shown. By using data augmentation algorithms it was possible to increase the accuracy of defect recognition and localization up to 70%. At the same time the stability of the algorithm under different deformations is investigated. It should also be noted that a detailed analysis of the distribution of defects in the image images (it is the spatial distribution, not quantitative) has been performed. The developed models can significantly enhance the monitoring of concrete structures without the use of invasive methods.

articleTitle: Predicting Analysis of the Multi-Sensor Signals in Terms of Time Series
abstract: This study is aimed to present a new way to predict multi-sensor signals values based on the given values registered before. The method is based on the generalised serialisation method, proposed by the author earlier, and autoregression with adjustable window width. The given signals have been received as a sequence of values related to a random instances of measurements. However there exist some patterns that imply the values to be not random in fact. It is natural in this proposition to consider all the signals came from the object to be predictable up to some precision due to the pattern for every signal exists. It is shown in the paper how to make such unification of the signals to receive the time series; there are various methods of prediction for the time series, and autoregression is chosen for this study; the generalised serialisation method allows to transform the value predicted by autoregression to the multi-values needed for prediction.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Learning Models for Solving Natural Language Processing Tasks
abstract: The paper contains an analytical review of methods for solving problems of semantically coherent text processing, search and selection of learning models for solving text processing problems, comparison of the obtained results, summarising the results. The learning models provided in Hugging Face and Scikit-Learn library for solving text generation, text tone detection and text classification tasks were selected for the study. As a result of the study, a comparative analysis of learning models for solving natural language processing tasks was carried out. Various machine learning methods such as SGDClassifier, KNeighborsClassifier, MultinomialNB, LogisticRegression, Decision TreeClassifier, RandomForestClassifier, support vector method and others were considered.

articleTitle: The Distribution Algorithm of Data Flows Based on the BIRCH Clustering in the Internal Distribution Mechanism
abstract: Today, the internal distribution approach is gaining ground in research related to large data streams. The internal distribution mechanism allows to achieve efficiency by applying the allocation mechanism on a single computing machine. In other words, storage, processing, and analysis of data flows based on the mechanism of internal distribution is one of the effective approaches in terms of both time and economic indicators. However, in this approach, the efficiency is closely related to the distribution module. That is, only the distribution of data flows based on specific rules will give the expected result. This research work is devoted to the development of an algorithm for the distribution of data streams in the internal distribution mechanism. In the study, the algorithm of distribution of data streams based on the Birch clustering method is considered. During the research, the capabilities of the clustering method are highlighted, and the distribution algorithm is developed based on this method. At the same time, the results obtained during the experiments are described and analyzed.

articleTitle: Modeling of a Digital Twin of an Automated Production Process
abstract: The article discusses the methodology for modeling a digital twin of an automated production process. The basis of the methodology is the method of intellectual analysis and information processing, which involves identifying patterns in the features, characteristics and parameters of the production process, forming classifiers for them according to various criteria in order to determine and predict the behavior of the process. The proposed digital twin modeling technique allows us to take into account hidden connections between the characteristics of the production process and their combinations, which increases the accuracy of forecasting changes in process behavior and, as a result, increases the efficiency of its management. As an example, the use of the proposed approaches for modeling a digital twin of automated assembly operations is considered.

articleTitle: Power Outage Warning System
abstract: This article discusses an alert system designed to inform the public about power outages. The reasons for the occurrence of interruptions are described, as well as the methods and technologies used to create an alert system. Various types of notifications are considered, such as SMS, phone calls, Internet notifications, etc. The authors also analyze the effectiveness of existing notification systems and propose a new software package to solve this problem. The new solution is a combined approach to notification. Software has been developed that allows you to connect any power supply company and thereby affect most of the geography of consumers. The consumer is given the opportunity to choose a convenient notification method by using the application. These innovations are aimed at improving the efficiency of informing in case of power outages. This solution was tested in the laboratory of the North Caucasus Federal University.

articleTitle: Dynamic Playbooks Quality Metrics
abstract: The text discusses the challenges and solutions related to dynamic control objects in the task of information security monitoring. New approaches for data collection and analysis, as well as the development of methods for creating dynamic incident response scenarios (playbooks), are highlighted. The focus is on resolving these challenges through the creation of applicable algorithms, models, methods, and security management approaches, including at the level of organizational processes, data handling, and formation of the organization's information security architecture. The work examines the problem of validating dynamic incident response scenarios in information security. Since it is impractical to allocate separate time for validation when forming a dynamic scenario, this issue is addressed through the selection of quality metrics applicable to the task. A set of quality metrics for a dynamic playbook is proposed, considering their use in the continuous detection and response cycle to information security incidents. An experiment confirming the applicability of these metrics in practice is conducted. The results can be used for simulation models, forming test scenarios for incident response, and improving existing static scenarios. Furthermore, the results can be integrated into orchestration tools for information protection systems, enhancing the effectiveness of information security incident response.

articleTitle: Advanced Algorithms for Distributed File Systems: Copying and Comparison
abstract: Operations on large file trees in a DFS (Distributed File System)-server are a bottleneck in large-scale cloud computing, such as distributed build systems for large software projects. Such operations take much longer than local operations, although the remote file system looks like a local directory to the user after mounting. Typical examples are (1) copying a file tree from a local file system to a remote file system and (2) computing the differences between the local and remote file trees. Speeding up these operations is possible if the specified DFS capabilities are utilized and the DFS driver and metadata layer are understood. In this paper, solutions for BeeGFS are proposed that allow speeding up the copying operation by a factor of 5-6, and the comparison operation by a factor of ten. The proposed approaches can be generalized and applied to other DFS types with some effort.

articleTitle: Development of Regulatory Documents for Calculating Electrical Loads of Single-Family Homes Using Big Data
abstract: The construction of single-family homes in the Russian Federation is one of the priority areas necessary to improve the standard of living of the population. At the same time, for the construction of electrical networks in residential villages, there are no regulatory documents with a modern regulatory framework for the design of electrical networks. Sustainable development of private and industrial construction of single-family homes is possible only with the development of regulatory technical documents that meet modern requirements. To accomplish this task, research work was carried out to develop regulatory documents used in the design of electrical networks of residential villages located in rural areas of the Republic of Tatarstan. Statistical analysis of big data, including half-hourly electrical loads and building characteristics as a function of time and period of year for more than 1900 single-family homes (more than 12.5 million electrical load values) located in rural areas, obtained from smart meters, showed that their the level differs from the electrical loads of single-family homes in urban areas, which explains the advisability of separating them into a separate group. After processing big data, graphs of maximum specific electrical loads were obtained, which will make it possible to develop a regulatory document for the design of electrical networks in residential villages.

articleTitle: On the Issue of Studying the Dependence of Magnetic Fields Created by Solenoids in the Acoustic Paths of Magnetostrictive Linear Displacement Sensors on their Parameters and Changes in Distance from its Center
abstract: The article is devoted to the study of the dependences of magnetic fields created by solenoids when changing its parameters and the distance from the OZ axis relative to the center of the solenoid. Both theoretical studies and computational experiments are carried out to determine the value of the projection on the OZ axis of the magnetic field strength of the solenoid from its inner and outer radii when its length and z coordinate change relative to its center. The results of the experiment allowed us to conclude that changing the internal and external radii of the solenoid is an effective way to change the value of its tension. It was also determined that changing the length of the solenoid is a less effective way to change the value of its tension. To confirm the correctness of the mathematical model used to calculate the magnetic field strength of the solenoid, an experimental test was carried out to determine the magnetic field of the solenoid, the results of which coincided with the results of the computational experiment. Since the use of magnetostrictive sensors in many areas, including as part of robotic systems, makes it possible to increase their sensitivity, accuracy, stability and reliability, which contributes to improving the efficiency and functionality of robotic systems, the materials presented in the article are relevant and have a practical focus.

articleTitle: Steganography Techniques for Encrypted Cover File
abstract: Data transmission over unsecured communication channels is still the biggest challenge in terms of security of transmitted data. One of the most significant trends in 2023 is attacks on secure data transmission systems. In addition, more and more attacks are targeting healthcare organizations. Therefore, the authors propose a steganographic system designed to further protect medical data transmitted over the network. This system includes both cryptographic and steganographic methods. A functional model of the embedding and extraction process has been developed. A breakdown of the basic process into four steps is described. An expert study is conducted to determine the most appropriate method of steganographic data embedding. An experimental study to determine the most appropriate cryptographic method of data protection is also carried out. Quality indicators of steganographic embedding in the container image encrypted by different cryptographic methods are calculated.

articleTitle: A New TSK Gaussian Fuzzy Inference System with Principal Component Weight
abstract: Nowadays, fuzzy inference systems provide extremely effective support in solving many problems in human life. Among them is the strong performance and application of Takagi-Sugeno-Kang (TSK) fuzzy inference system. In this study, a new Gaussian fuzzy TSK system using principal component analysis method is proposed to reduce the capacity of fuzzy rule system when the number of input criteria is relatively large, and at the same time, the model has improvements when considering the weight value of input criteria by determining the contribution proportion of input information. The model uses the entropy minimization approach (MEPA) to provide effective support for the fuzzification process of series input data. The proposed model is applied to forecast the socio-economic development index of 63 provinces in Vietnam, and the input data are the socio-economic development indicators of 63 provinces in 2019. The forecasting results of the proposed system are evaluated and analyzed by comparing the forecasted and actual values, and evaluating the values of MSE, RMSE, MAPE and CORR between the model using weighted and the model not using weighted values. Using weighted values shows that the proposed model has much better performance.

articleTitle: Industrial Data-Driven Control
abstract: Currently due to growth of manufacturing business the requirement for informatization and automation is increasing. However, the market situation shows that in many cases computer workstations are not linked and personnel have to do double work in order to achieve data relevance along the entire enterprise. Given this it becomes necessary to implement the mechanism, which enables information system management and allows to quickly respond to external changes, as well as predict the possible behaviour of the system under specified conditions. The purpose of the work is to design a control system based on the use of a data-driven management approach, which contains an interface for interaction with the information system, and implements control logic based on the rules of system behaviour. This paper discusses the general provisions of the problem, the methods used to build a control system, the place of the control system in the information complex of production and describes the proposed approach and further research trend.

articleTitle: Detection of Cyberbullying in Texts Posted by Users of Social Networks Using Machine Learning
abstract: Despite all the benefits that social networks have brought to the world, they also serve as a favorable environment for the growth of electronic crime. This article explores issues related to the detection of cyberbullying in texts posted by social media users using machine learning. It is noted that the social network VKontakte will be used as the social platform for gathering information in the research. The proposed approach consists of three main stages: pre-processing, feature extraction, and the classification stage. Feature extraction is performed using TF-IDF. Additionally, sentiment analysis is employed alongside TF -IDF to extract the polarity of sentences and add them as features to the feature list. The study utilizes five machine learning classifiers: Support Vector Machine, k-Nearest Neighbors, Logistic Regression, Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM). The article concludes with an assessment of the classifier's accuracy and relevant conclusions are drawn.

articleTitle: Research the Potential for Energy Saving and Maximizing Productivity in Rectilinear Transitions of a Collaborative Robot
abstract: Since for collaborative robotic technological processes the most important indicators of operational efficiency, in addition to the degree of safety, are productivity and energy efficiency, this article presents an algorithm for calculating energy costs and execution time of the simplest technological operation - linear movement of the tool center point (TCP) depending on the choice linear speed change graph profile. To demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed practical solutions, the work presents an example of modeling the implementation of a KUKA LBR iiwa 7 R800 collaborative robot for rectilinear movement of TCP from one point to another in the MATLAB environment. The simulation results showed significant potential for energy savings and increased productivity, both for a selected range of robot configurations and in the space of all possible configurations in relation to LIN-type technological movements within a collaborative process.

articleTitle: A System for Processing Large Volumes of Text Information Using Neural Networks
abstract: This paper presents the implementation of a system for summarizing large amounts of text information using neural networks. Relevance of this system is due to the need to obtain a large amount of knowledge in a very short time. The system works through the telegram bot interface. Telegram bot provides the ability to generate an annotation for input text and output the result as text file. Programming language used is Python. PostgreSQL database management system was chosen to store the data. To implement the system, data was collected, with the help of which the model was further trained. A parser was implemented to collect data. Multilingual mBART model was chosen as the initial model. To evaluate the model of summarization problem, the ROUGE metric was used. The result is a system that allows to obtain reliable information in compressed, accessible form, namely in the form of a text file, for further analysis.

articleTitle: Ultrasonic Location System of a Reconfigurable Mobile Robot
abstract: The performance characteristics of an ultrasonic sensor as part of a mobile wheel-track robot with a reconfigurable structure have been studied. The sensor allows obtaining information for the control system in order to autonomously overcome obstacles by the robot. The robot overcomes obstacles by lifting the wheels relative to the tracks at a certain angle, which is determined by the size of the obstacle exceeding the height of the tracked platform. A robot control algorithm has been developed to overcome obstacles. An experimental robot model that implements this algorithm was created and tested. The operating characteristics of the ultrasonic sensor were obtained and analyzed in various modes for determining the distance to obstacles and the height of the obstacles. Recommendations on optimal speed and distance measurement parameters were developed. The influence of the material, width and shape of obstacles on the measurement error was determined.

articleTitle: Implementation of Regular Topologies for NoCs Based on schoolMIPS Soft-Processor Cores
abstract: This article describes the implementation of regular topologies for networks-on-chip. The complexity of network development and its main parameters depend on the choice of topology. The rationale for the influence of topology on network bandwidth is given. Software that automates the generation of configuration files (bitstream) for the implementation of networks-on-chip with different topologies and with different routing algorithms on two FPGAs was developed. This software also calculates the basic parameters of topologies. The impact of routing algorithms on network performance is shown. The implementations, advantages and disadvantages of the XY and OE routing algorithms are represented.

articleTitle: Automating Electric Power Consumption with a Smart Electricity Meter
abstract: The development of radioelectronics in the 21st century is associated with the automation of human activities and the monitoring and measurement of production process parameters. Using wireless communication systems facilitates the remote monitoring of parameters and provides opportunities for realtime control. The efficiency of Internet of Things devices can be achieved through the rational distribution of loads, thus providing a design potential for energy-efficient smart city or smart house systems. The monitoring of power consumption is an important step toward the efficient usage of energy resources. It helps increase the operational reliability, environmental performance, and safety of electronic devices. This article discusses the usage of wireless and cloud technology for the optimization and monitoring of power consumption by smart house and smart city systems. The authors analyzed the key integration areas for the technical solution based on the Internet of Things concept. They developed a smart meter module and data processing algorithms that provide power consumption recommendations. The smart meter consists of a regular electricity meter and an extension module with a wireless connection. The data is processed with the SmartThings platform.
