The experimental data obtained on the laboratory setup showed the efficiency of the algorithms used and the efficiency of integrating the meter into the existing systems, as well as the economic feasibility of the solution.

articleTitle: Separation of Optimal Controlled Motion into Components
abstract: As a result of analytical and numerical experiments, an analytical control dependence (translational acceleration) on the polynomial degree is found and investigated; the total movement and motion time are set in advance. If the degree of acceleration polynomial increases, energy costs to realize the optimal object motion (acceleration-braking type) decrease. The smallest polynomial degree is 1 and the known classical control follows. If the degree (it is always odd) increases, then less energy-intensive control appears. In all cases, quiescence occurs in the final position and control is turned off. The designing algorithm leads to universal analytic dependencies and it is based on the reversive optimality principle, the ultimate purpose of which is a reconstructed functional-criterion that takes on a minimum value. The algorithmic features of the constructed control are noted, and its comparison with the known one (that was found using the variational method of the optimal control theory) is given. It is shown that it is possible to separate the phases of controlled motion into acceleration, uniform movement and deceleration. This object's sequential motions implementation is illustrated by numerical example when comparing classical and constructed controls. A special function “picewise” (from the Maple) is used to obtain a graphical description of the motion model. The conclusion draws attention to the applications of research results in various fields of modern technology.

articleTitle: Movement Control of a SCARA-Type Manipulator via the Brain-Computer Interface
abstract: The article considers the process of control of spatial movement of the SCARA-type robot-manipulator with the use of the visual evoked potentials (VEP) based brain-computer interface (BCI). The design and general layout of the control system of the control object are described. Software (software) has been developed to provide visual stimuli, receive and process electroencephalogram (EEG) data, and to form control commands. Then the speed and accuracy of the brain-computer interface is evaluated. An experiment was carried out with the participation of a group of subjects, during which they were to control the executive device in different modes. As a result, it is found that the developed brain-computer interface can be used for effective control of the movement of the manipulator.

articleTitle: Development of the Decentralized Biometric Identity Verification System Using Blockchain Technology and Computer Vision
abstract: This article investigates the creation of a decentralized system for biometric-based identity verification, integrating blockchain technology and computer vision. The goal is to provide a secure verification method, minimizing identity fraud and transactional deceptions. The system combines facial recognition, fingerprint scanning, and iris scanning, ensuring precise individual identification. Blockchain guarantees data immutability and decentralization, ensuring biometric data integrity. Computer vision enhances biometric data processing, improving system accuracy and efficiency. Key components include blockchain for secure biometric data storage via Solidity-based smart contracts, computer vision algorithms like convolutional neural networks for facial image analysis, and the OpenPGP library for asymmetric encryption. The system's backend is developed in Python using FastAPI, with a React-based frontend for user interaction. This web application is compatible with modern browsers and integrates seamlessly with existing systems. Results show the development of a novel blockchain-based decentralized identity system, employing a Solidity smart contract for encrypted biometric data storage and a React and FastAPI web application for facial image analysis. The system ensures data privacy through asymmetric encryption and has undergone extensive testing, proving significant advantages over conventional solutions. The discussion emphasizes the system's benefits in secure, efficient, and accurate identity verification, suitable for various sectors like finance, healthcare, and government services. The system's future could involve expanding biometric modalities, algorithmic optimization, and incorporating emerging technologies like the Internet of Things.

articleTitle: Architecture of the High-Tech Manufacturing Automation System on the Basis of the Digital Twin
abstract: The paper presents an architecture of the Industry 4.0 enterprise production management system based on digital twins of plant and products. The principles of creating and employing the digital twins in the course of the product life cycle are defined. We demonstrate the example structure of an integrated manufacturing automation system that includes digital twins and a number of other systems. The functions of digital twins in such a system are indicated. The domain ontology is described as a semantic basis for integrating numerous disparate models that comprise the digital twins. In order to formalize and automate a digital twin development process, we propose to apply novel mathematical methods based on category theory.

articleTitle: Development of the Principle of Operation of Smart Clothing Managing Human Fatigue Under Conditions of Thermal Discomfort
abstract: Bigger spend of the biophysical resources in cold leads to decrease in the general physical and mental activity of the person, which affects efficiency and accuracy in terms of the work performance. Therefore, development of the smart thermal-protective industrial clothing with remote monitoring and automatic correction of motor actions of the person wearing it, based the of Internet of Things technologies, is an urgent task to reduce production risks. The following functional principle is suggested as the basis to address the tasks above: clothing with the ability to remotely monitor human motor resources before the fatigue transition phase and automated mode control. A smart thermal protective suit with the physical activity safe mode control function is developed on the basis of the described technical solution. The developed system for monitoring and analyzing human fatigue in clothing under cold conditions and promptly adjusting human motor mode was experimentally tested with data on accumulation of the proposed human fatigue index. With the help of the developed principle and technical solutions of smart clothing that manages human fatigue in the thermal discomfort conditions, the person working in the cold and gradually moving into a risky state of his performance, as well as the specialist in charge of the occupational health and safety at the facilities, and specialists who analyses and plan the operational safety systems - all these employees get their own tools for monitoring and responsive regulation of the human physical actions both in the current situation and in the future.

articleTitle: Intelligent On-Line System for Monitoring Technical Condition of High-Voltage Cable Couplings
abstract: The article provides the characteristics of the end cable couplings of the closed switchgear 110 kV at the electric steelmaking workshop of the metallurgical plant. The functions of the continuous technical condition monitoring system are substantiated, including continuous temperature monitoring and on-line registration of partial discharges in the insulation. The first function provides monitoring of the operational load, and the second has the maximum sensitivity for diagnosing defect propagation. A functional diagram of the developed intelligent on-line system for monitoring technical condition with digital signal transmission is provided. The choice of sensors and processor unit is justified. The authors consider the temperature control system of high-voltage equipment “WDM-T”, including a wireless sensor and an information receiver. The results of monitoring the thermal regime are provided, the advantages of partial discharge analysis are pointed out. The temperature trends of the end couplings included in the cable line phases are considered. The system is implemented on the closed switchgear 110 kV end couplings, its long-term operation has confirmed the effectiveness of technical condition monitoring. The developed system may be a component of an on-line cyberphysical system for monitoring the condition of high-voltage equipment in the electric steelmaking workshop.

articleTitle: Development and Analysis of Subsystem Models of Message Queues Transmitted within both a Reconfigurable Computing System and Accessing the System-Shared Memory
abstract: The author of the article presents the main methods of implementing message transmission between processes in modern reconfigurable systems. The objective of this scholarly paper is to examine and explore approaches to the administration of interacting processes. In the article are also displayed the exchange between parallel processes in reconfigurable multiprocessor systems, the drawbacks of software implementations of this mechanism. The characteristics, obtained on functional models and made in the VHDL language, show the high performance of the subsystem of message queues transmitted within the reconfigurable computing system and when accessing the shared memory of the system. There is proposed a type of hardware accelerator that performs the functions of process synchronization. The results of modeling are presented. In addition, in this article are considered some of the methods of interprocess communication using the example of named pipes and shared memory. There is an examination of the issues regarding the study of software tools for measuring the performance of interprocess communication channels. The methods of interprocess communication considered in the article have different performance, that was measured using the 1mbench software package. The primary outcomes of the conducted tests are visually represented in the diagrams. Towards the conclusion of the research article, a comparative analysis between channels and shared memory is presented, focusing on two key parameters: bandwidth and latency. In conclusion, there are drawn the main conclusions and provided an outline of the objectives for the further research on this topic.

articleTitle: Research on Combined GNSS/IMU/Camera Positioning and Navigation in Full Scene
abstract: In a limited environment with GPS signals, the accuracy of visual positioning of a moving platform based on sequential images is high and can correct the accumulation of errors in the path calculation method. However, positioning can easily fail in environments with poor texture or insufficient lighting. To improve the accuracy and reliability of positioning a moving platform in all scene conditions, a combined navigation method using GPS, camera, inertial measurement unit (IMU), and odometry based on joint filtering is proposed. In this method, the IMU is used to form sub-filters with the help of an odometer and camera within the joint filtering, effectively avoiding positioning failures of the system caused by stereoscopic vision failures and enhancing the reliability of positioning. Experiments show that the new method can compensate for problems of loss of signals from the vehicle's satellite navigation system and errors of the inertial device, accumulating and diverging over time, as well as improving the accuracy and reliability of the system in complex conditions.

articleTitle: Effect of Conductor and Dielectric Arrangement on the Protective Characteristics of Protection Devices in Common and Differential Modes
abstract: The paper presents the results of simulation devices used to protect equipment in differential and common modes against pulse interference. We investigate how conductor arrangement on the outer and inner layers, as well as the filling of dielectric with air and the radio absorbing material (RAM), influence the device protective characteristics. The results demonstrate that when the dielectric is filled with the RAM, and the active conductors are located internally, the attenuation coefficient is 1.31 times less in common and 1.22 times less in differential than when the conductors are located externally. For air-filled dielectric together with the active conductors located inside, the attenuation coefficient is 1.33 times less in common and 1.15 times less in differential than with their external location. The maximum attenuation coefficient is achieved with air-filled dielectric, otherwise the attenuation coefficient is less by a factor of 1.2 times. The research shows that to achieve the best attenuation coefficient, the external arrangement of active conductors is preferred together with the air as dielectric.

articleTitle: Synthesis and Experimental Research of Fault Detection System for Actuators of Robot Manipulator by Technical Vision
abstract: The paper considers synthesis of system for detection of faults in sensors and electric drives of manipulation robots. During the operation of the system, the position of the manipulator and its links is determined using a vision system with a stereo camera and a marker located on the manipulator's working tool. This position is then compared with the position calculated from the readings of the rotation angle sensors of each joint of the manipulator The conclusion about the presence of a fault is made from the analysis of the results of this comparison. To test the operability of the proposed system, an experimental study was conducted using a MITSUBISHI RV-2FB manipulator. The experimental results confirmed the efficiency of the method.

articleTitle: Construction of Underwater Hydroacoustic Networks
abstract: This study addresses the issue of effective management and monitoring of aquatic territories using hydroacoustic systems. It analyzes the existing problem of data transmission constraints and coordination of hydroacoustic modems in hydroacoustic networks. The paper proposes a concept for creating a network user interface for hydroacoustic systems to overcome these limitations and enhance the efficiency of underwater communication systems. The main focus is on analyzing the necessity and potential of developing network interfaces for managing hydroacoustic networks, as well as presenting principles and methods for integrating network technologies into hydroacoustic systems. Additionally, the advantages and prospects of applying the developed network interfaces in various underwater scenarios are discussed.

articleTitle: Analysis of Deformability of Non-Rigid Cylindrical Parts during Robotic Assembly Using a Force Torque Sensor
abstract: The behavior of non-rigid cylindrical pieces during robotic assembly is taken into account in the research. The solution to the automated assembly problem is further complicated by the requirements to account for the deformation of the elastic shaft due to its low stiffness. On the basis of the identification of the output signals from a force torque sensor, a model is provided for detecting the kind of deformation of a part. We find the relationships between the coupling depth and the bending stiffness at the contact locations and the shaft deformation parameters. The values of deflections and rotational angles with two-point contact determined during the connection of a non-rigid shaft with a rigid sleeve enable the robot's output link to move correctly during assembly. An industrial robot from ABB called the IRB-140 with an IRC5 controller and a force torque sensor from the business “Schunk” was used for the experiment.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Methods of Symptom Extraction from Medical Notes
abstract: Medical notes contain valuable information about patient conditions, treatments, and progress. Extracting symptoms from these unstructured notes is crucial for clinical research, population health analysis, and decision support systems. Traditional manual methods are time-consuming, but recent advances in natural language processing (NLP) and machine learning offer automated solutions. This article presents a novel approach that combines NLP techniques, such as conditional random fields (CRF) and transformer-based architectures. The proposed method demonstrates effective symptom extraction from medical notes, overcoming challenges such as varied terminologies and linguistic nuances. The study utilizes a dataset of Russian medical records, transforming it into a tabular format for training and employing unique tokenization algorithms for different models. Among the evaluated models, RuBERT achieved the highest accuracy of 91%, indicating its strong performance on the test dataset. SBERT exhibited the highest precision and F1 score, suggesting its effectiveness in accurately identifying specific sequence labels.

articleTitle: Development of the Vitrification Furnace Digital Twin Using a Digital Platform
abstract: The article discusses main features of the developing process of a vitrification furnace digital twin, including a description of a set of mathematical models as part of a product digital twin and describing the connection between models and the order of their creation. Vitrification furnace is a complex high-tech industrial product combining many physical phenomena that are closely interrelated to each other. The purpose of this work is to determine the significance of using digital twin technology in the development of such complex knowledge-intensive devices. Also this article describes the benefits of using digital platforms in a context of automating data collection and their transfer between computer models. Developed by engineers from Peter the Great St. Petersburg Polytechnic University the digital platform CML- Bench is used. The article describes both main components of the platform and key features of use.

articleTitle: Methods, Models and Hardware-Software Complex of Distributed Monitoring Based on Iot and Blockchain Technology
abstract: This research work explores the possibility of simultaneous use of Industry 4.0 technologies, namely the Internet of Things (IoT) and distributed systems (Blockchain) for collecting, processing, storing and confirming the adequacy of environmental data characterizing the state of sources of anthropogenic impact significantly distributed throughout the study area. It also describes the dynamics of the quality of natural environments during the dispersion and accumulation of pollutants. This approach is especially important for the implementation of market relations in the field of carbon quotas giving the possibility of redistributing the area of responsibility of production enterprises. The authors have developed a subsystem of an automated environmental safety management system, including a hardware and software complex that, based on Internet of Things technology, allows for the collection and integration of heterogeneous environmental information received from various sensors with its further storage and processing in a cloud system. The proposed subsystem, based on distributed registry technology, ensures openness and accessibility of the environmental data. It suggests decentralization of subsequent management decisions, so that it includes a specialized digital platform developed by the authors. The corresponding models and algorithms are presented in the research work, and their software implementation is developed.

articleTitle: Routing Based on Temporal Characteristics of Information Interaction of Local Infocommunication Systems Nodes
abstract: Infocommunication systems belong to the class of complex managed systems. The property of complexity predetermines the multi-criteria for assessing the quality of management and the multi-aspect nature of the system properties analysis. One main task of managing the state in info communication system is the task of routing message transmission. Approaches to choosing an approach to managing routing in a particular info communication system depend on the stability of its topology. This article discusses an approach to assessing the topology stability of the an infocommunication system based on the nature of the nodes information interaction, that is, the topology of information interaction, invariant to the nature of the transmitted information.

articleTitle: Methods and Algorithms for Implementation of Imitation Approach to Modeling of Physicochemical Processes
abstract: This article describes the key methods and algorithms to organize the study of complex physicochemical processes using the imitation approach to modeling. The imitation approach to modeling is based on running a series of statistical tests and subsequent digital processing of all elementary particle interactions. Using this approach for the integration of digital technology helps review complex molecular interactions and reaction dynamics on a level that cannot be attained in experimentation. The authors describe the main idea of the imitation approach to modeling based on the representation of the kinetic mechanism of elementary reactions. They present a step-by-step algorithm for the reproduction of the molecular weight distribution curve based on the idea of the fractionation of the established data array by molecular weight. The software implementation of this algorithm adapted for the operation with large numbers helped solve the problem of assessing the molecular parameters of the isoprene polymerization product over a neodymium catalyst. The obtained molecular weight distribution curve is aligned with the results of Flory's model distribution. Additionally calculated values of average molecular weights showed sufficient alignment with the result of kinetic approach organization and the results of laboratory experiments.

articleTitle: Control of the Electric Drive Shutdown by Applying the SDRE Method
abstract: The possibility of controlling the shutdown of an electric drive with a direct current electric motor of sequential excitation according to the feedback principle is investigated. The existing methods of analytical design of this kind of control are not suitable due to the nonlinear properties of the dynamics of the electric motor. The SDRE method of synthesis of nonlinear control systems is used to solve the problem. It is used to build an algorithm for stopping the electric drive, which allows for a smooth decrease in the speed of rotation of the drive shaft for a given time.

articleTitle: Automation of Predicting Malfunctions of Medical Equipment
abstract: During the analysis, it was revealed that modern medical treatment and preventive care institution AO “Medicina”, in particular, faces a number of challenges related to the management of technical and user operation of medical equipment. To solve these problems, changes are required in the system of maintenance and repair of medical equipment, as well as the constant development of personnel training in the operation of equipment. Predicting the service life of medical equipment components is an important component of a decision support system aimed at reducing the downtime of faulty medical equipment associated with the purchase and supply of necessary spare and consumable parts. To study the quality of the assessment, data on the service life of spare parts and identified faults obtained from the medical equipment in use in the medical treatment and preventive care institution AO “Medicina” were used. The lack of an analytical unit and the ability to provide statistics makes it difficult to plan procurement activities for spare parts. As a result of the research, a software implementation of the information system and a forecasting module was carried out and tested in the conditions of medical treatment and preventive care institution AO “Medicina”. Thanks to the forecast of the service life of the PHoX Plus analyzer parts, it was possible to adjust the purchase of consumable parts downwards.

articleTitle: Mathematical Modeling of Tethered Platform Vertical Flight
abstract: There is a quickly obtaining problem of sufficient information about the environment, including in hard-to-reach areas without communication or long-term stationary monitoring in order to ensure the safety or security of important objects. A possible solution to this problem is the use of tethered unmanned aerial platforms capable of staying in the air for a long time without landing. The power supply of such platforms, as well as the transmission of information from the equipment installed on board, is carried out through a cable. Purpose of the study: to create tools for designing tethered flying platforms equipped with an automated cable retention system, taking into account random atmospheric disturbances during vertical flight. The results of mathematical modeling of automated cable flying platform plant - tethered copter taking into account random atmospheric disturbances are presented. During mathematical modeling of the vertical position of the tethered copter, the extended Kalman filter algorithm was used, which made it possible to estimate the state variables of the tethered platform under random disturbances of the atmosphere as a partially deterministic medium.

articleTitle: Development and Testing of an Artificial Neural Network Model to Analyse Data, Image Data
abstract: The relevance of the study is related to the increased needs of medical personnel in qualitative solution of image data analysis tasks, in particular lung scans during the period of controlling the consequences of coronavirus infection. An artificial neural network model was developed and tested to improve the quality of research results, reduce time, and optimise the work of medical staff. A convolutional neural network was chosen as a tool to solve this problem. The tools and software products most commonly used to build and design artificial neural networks were analysed. Python programming language and PyQt5 framework were used as tools for conducting software product development and testing. Three architectures were involved in the experiment, and the number of layers, epochs, average epoch training time and network accuracy were taken into account to evaluate their efficiency. It was found that the optimal architecture is the one consisting of 9 layers, 10 epochs, giving an accuracy of 72.39%. The effectiveness of the regularisation methods for modifying the convolutional neural network on the publicly available CIFAR-10 dataset was evaluated. Among the six modification methods considered, the modification using a combination of Weight Initialisation and Batch Normalisation methods was preferred. Next, Data Augmentation method was applied to the base models and modifications to reduce overfitting. However, using Data Augmentation in conjunction with other regularisers resulted in worse results. The interface of convolutional neural network was developed. The result of the study was a convolutional neural network with 90% accuracy.

articleTitle: Agent-Service Approach to Building Digital Twins
abstract: The article discusses the problem of constructing digital twins based on the agent-service approach. The concept of digital twins is considered taking into account GOST of the Russian Federation (RF), and the author's ontological approach to the design of digital twins is given. The interaction of various agents and a description of scenarios for their interaction based on event modeling using Joiner networks are described. The main types of agents are identified. The proposed approach allows you to scale systems, change the composition of digital twins without significant changes in the architecture, and organize their interaction with each other. The article discusses the application of the proposed approach in the development of a digital twin of renewable energy sources (solar power plant).

articleTitle: Prediction of the Degree of Metallization of Hot Briquetted Iron
abstract: The development of a predictive model for the degree of metallization of hot briquetted iron is one of the urgent tasks of metallurgical science. The article discusses global and domestic experience in analyzing data on the operation of HBI plants and the possibility of predicting the quality of manufactured products. It is noted that the Midrex iron ore recovery technology has received the most widespread use and study in world practice. The authors of the article propose an algorithm for predicting the degree of metallization of a restored product based on clustering input raw materials according to their metallurgical and chemical properties and constructing a regression model based on a set of technological parameters of the Midrex process, which have a direct impact on product quality. The article provides a comparative analysis of regression analysis methods using machine learning, as a result of which random forest was selected as the most optimal method in terms of the root mean square error of prediction (RMSE). The developed algorithm can be used in production to solve problems of operational control of the iron recovery process in order to improve the quality of manufactured products.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator
Author Keywords: prediction of the degree of metallization

articleTitle: Edge IIoT in Manufacturing
abstract: There have been many studies on the integration of edge computing technology into the Internet of Things and its integration into the operation of various processes that require greater adaptability in dealing with information and better utilization of available resources. Indeed, in recent years there has been an active exploration of new ways to utilize this technology. However, most research has focused on the development of new architectural solutions and in the area of integration with various smart systems such as smart home or smart health care, with little attention to the application of this technology in industrial production. However, it is recognized that this technology is a new step in improving IT/OT convergence, which makes this technology highly relevant for industrial applications. This study explores the principles of edge within the enterprise digital transformation and proposes a model in which edge technology is integrated into the operation of an automated warehouse management system in manufacturing. The study shows that that technology can be used to filter previously unused data in order to better identify possible defects in the system by obtaining additional data without the need to manually upload it.

articleTitle: Cyber-Physical Systems in Pond Aquaculture
abstract: The article dwells on the new solution to the fish farming automation problem. The solution is based on the cyber-physical paradigm. The article discusses the parameters that need to be controlled for proper fish growth as well as the existing types of feed distributors. The development of an automatic feed dispenser capable of providing accurate feed preparation and adaptation to various fish conditions is described. The algorithm of operation of the cyber-physical system of automatic feeding of fish in a pond farm is developed. A monitoring system was also proposed for the transmission and analysis of fish feeding data, which allows optimizing the feeding process and monitoring of the condition of fish. The cyber-physical system allows not only to analyze the state of the pond economy but also to predict the productivity of ponds.

articleTitle: Robotic Complex for Assessing the Condition of Electrical Equipment of Substations
abstract: This article describes the development and testing of a robotic complex for automating the processes of thermal imaging and visual inspection of electrical equipment of electrical substations with voltages of 110 kV and higher. A prototype of a robotic complex was developed taking into account the size of substations for movement and software was written in accordance with regulatory requirements established in the electric power industry for thermal imaging and visual inspection of electrical equipment of electrical substations, which are represented by the “Operator” and “Analyzer” software packages. The capabilities of the developed robotic complex and software were tested on the 110/10 kV transformer model, and a malfunction of the transformer cooling system was identified. The results obtained show the promise of using a robotic complex for diagnosing electrical equipment. The prospects for using a robotic complex to assess the technical condition of electrical equipment in substations are shown.

articleTitle: Analysis of Graphic Images to Expand Descriptions of Physical Effects
abstract: Often, the description of the physical effect in the “primary” sources of information (patent documents, journal articles of a physical profile, dissertations in physics) contains graphs of dependencies linking the physical quantities of the input and output impacts of the physical effect (PhE). The analysis of this information and its use to expand the description of the physical effect is an urgent task. A modification of the model for describing the physical effect was carried out, taking into account the graphical representation of the functional dependence of the physical quantities of the PhE. CNN, LSTM, Visual Transformer (ViT) neural networks and machine learning methods of Naive Bayes, SVM have been tested in relation to classification and recognition tasks on images of dependency graphs. A comparative analysis of the approaches (accuracy of definition, complexity of data preparation, fault tolerance, equipment requirements) was carried out using criteria of precision, recall, F-measure, AUC-ROC.

articleTitle: Algorithms for Recognizing Railway Infrastructure Objects in Images
abstract: Two algorithms for recognizing railway infrastructure objects in images are presented. The first algorithm is detecting potentially dangerous railway infrastructure objects and elements that determine the movement of trains. The second algorithm implies segmenting the main and auxiliary railway tracks, as well as trains in the direction of motion of the locomotive. The algorithms are implemented using YOLO and U-Net convolutional neural networks (CNN). The RZD_dataset proposed by the Research and Design Institute of Design Information, Automation, and Communication on Railway Transport was used to train and test the CNN. To increase the precision of object detection, we expanded the source image base, selected the best topology of the algorithm and augmented the illumination in the HSV space. The algorithms work in real time. The average precision for 11 classes of the detection algorithm based on the mAP metric is 63.8%. The average precision for three classes of the segmentation algorithm based on the IoU metric is 84.5%.

articleTitle: Modification of Skeletal Character Animation Using Inverse Kinematics Controllers
abstract: The article discusses in detail the use of inverse and forward kinematics to modify skeletal character animation, with a focus on adapting existing 3D objects to specific project requirements. It highlights the limitations of existing assets and animations when integrating them into new projects. Two main approaches are presented, using the skeleton “wrapping” technique and animation retargeting to solve the problems of modifying existing animations. A practical solution is proposed to achieve the required motion animations without the need to implement a riggin and animation step from scratch. Thus, the proposed methods optimize the animation process to prepare the animation to the required quality and the development efficiency is improved.

articleTitle: Algorithm for Simultaneous Target Interception by Group of Unmanned Aerial Vehicles
abstract: The problem of developing an algorithm for group guidance of unmanned aerial vehicles with simultaneous target acquisition has been considered. It has been proposed to use an algorithm that consists of two stages. In the first stage, decentralized multi-agent control is used with a consensus algorithm in order to achieve equality in the measured parameters, which include the relative range to the target and the angle between the velocity vector of the unmanned aircraft and the line of sight of the target. In the second stage, each unmanned vehicle is separately guided towards the target using a modified three-dimensional proportional guidance algorithm. Numerical simulations have demonstrated the effectiveness of these methods.

articleTitle: Command System for a Robotic 3D Printing Complex Using DED Technology
abstract: In this work, a command system was developed and tested to control the three-dimensional printing of metal parts using a robotic complex operating using DED printing technology. An analysis of printing technology was carried out. A description of the structure of the equipment included in the complex is given. Based on an analysis of the functional purpose of the complex elements and their relationships, the requirements for the command system are formulated. When developing the command system, the need to simultaneously launch several sequential commands was taken into account. Based on the formulated requirements, a system of commands has been developed to control the printing of specific products. The command system provides the ability to partially set parameters (if, when executing a given command, some parameters must remain unchanged relative to the previous command). The developed command system has been successfully tested.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Main Security Threats of Videoconferencing Systems
abstract: Videoconferencing has become one of the most widespread means of communication in the modern world. In the era of epidemics, social distancing and increased speed of information exchange, videoconferencing has become a key means of interaction between subjects of information exchange in real time. As more and more diverse equipment with varying degrees of internal and external protection against information security threats is used in videoconferencing sessions, these sessions are becoming an increasingly vulnerable target for possible destructive influences. The range of these impacts is quite wide, and a number of system privacy settings are required to prevent them. However, in order to develop a comprehensive security system for videoconferencing, it is necessary to determine an exhaustive list of current threats to information security. This article identifies the main assets, vulnerabilities and potential threats to the videoconferencing system.

articleTitle: Study of Molten Steel Level Sensor
abstract: This article describes the study results of a molten metal level sensor for use in metallurgy. A study of coil models was carried out taking into account their proportions, and the results of the distribution of the magnetic field along their axis, as well as the current consumption and the level of eddy current losses in the molten metal and the mold body were obtained. The data obtained make it possible to evaluate the effectiveness of coil's various proportions and give recommendations on their choice. The distance from the sensor to the surface of the molten metal, which is the limit for this type of sensor, has been determined. All data is presented in the form of tables and convenient graphs, which allows readers to easily perceive the results of this study.

articleTitle: Automation of Athletes Identification in an Image
abstract: This paper deals with the task of athlete recognition in images from sports competitions. Identification of an athlete by recognising his start number allows to avoid problems connected with recognising athletes by face and allows to automate the process of tagging images from competitions. The paper provides a brief overview of various existing methods for localising objects and recognising text in images. The authors prepared and labelled several image datasets and described them in the paper. The authors developed models, which are based on the neural network architecture YOLO, to localise the athletes, filter out images that are unsuitable for number recognition, and recognise digits in athlete start numbers with high accuracy. Based on a combination of these models, the authors developed the start number recognition model, whose testing metrics are given in the paper.

articleTitle: Synthesis of Advanced Data Input System in Virtual and Augmented Reality System Interfaces
abstract: The paper deals with Industry 4.0 as an information industry in which computer systems and networks are highly integrated with physical manufacturing processes. It includes the use of various technologies such as the Internet of Things (IoT), Artificial Intelligence (AI), computer-aided manufacturing and design, data analytics, etc. One such technology is Virtual (VR) and Augmented Reality (AR). Data input in VR has great potential for Industry 4.0. The proposed technology can create more efficient and realistic training simulations, improve product design and creation processes, and develop new ways of interacting with information and data. The technology is proposed as add-ons to virtual and augmented reality helmets.

articleTitle: Web-Visualization of the Process of Controlling Operating Parameters of the Demonstration Bench on the Basis of Active Experiment in CoDeSys Environment
abstract: The paper presents a new approach to visualization of an additional extension (as a component of the execution system) of the CODESYS controller for displaying visualization screens (user interfaces) in a web-browser. The paper considers the implementation of the Web-visualization concept, which allows remote control of the visualization of the acoustic-magnetic geothermal water treatment process and its parameters using a web-browser on different hardware platforms, which provided a significant advantage in the flexibility of the control system. Web-based visualizations allow remote control of the process by graphically displaying the status of equipment and processes. Maintenance engineers involved with the application can perform their normal procedures much faster and at a lower cost, which confirms the usefulness of the application. The proposed experimental setup procedure can be applied to other processes, thus reducing the cost of performing experiments. The proposed solution uses Web-visualization techniques combined with communications based on the standards defined by IEC 61850. The developed prototype Web application is tested in a laboratory environment. The application allows visualization of automation data where required by using standard communications for real-time SCADA information.

articleTitle: Forward Erasure Correction Code for Short-Delay-Sensitive Messages at the QUIC
abstract: The current network protocols are designed for stable wired networks, but they struggle to perform optimally in wireless environments characterized by fluctuating round trip times, high packet losses, and connection migrations. Google's QUIC protocol, launched in 2012, offers a promising solution by providing higher performance than traditional TCP in practical engineering scenarios. The protocol's open-source nature allows for flexibility in adapting the network stack to specific application use cases. The objective of this study is to leverage the Google QUIC framework to achieve improvement in end-to-end delay for short-session scenarios. The study highlights the impact of packet losses in wireless networks, with loss rates ranging from 3.5% to 7% in congested areas. In a sequential exchange of small packets, the loss of any packet can prevent the session from completing, leading to service disruptions such as failed user authentication. Redundancy codes can enhance the reliability of data transmission by allowing the receiver to recover from errors without relying on successful retransmissions. This is particularly valuable in scenarios where retransmissions may themselves be prone to errors or further packet loss, which we discovered in this study and applied to real world applications.

articleTitle: Creating an Application with Mixed Reality Technology in the Field of Aircraft Engineering
abstract: This article discusses the creation of an application with mixed reality technology, in order to improve the learning process among 1st year students in the field of aircraft engineering. The application allows students to study the design of the drone, its main components, and consider how they work. This project is a Windows-based application for the Microsoft HoloLens 2 mixed reality helmet. The following tools and technologies were used to create the application: Unity 3D to create the program interface and test it, and MixedRealtyFeatureTool to add the necessary packages and plug-ins to work with mixed reality to the Unity project, as well as Visual Studio to write code and download the application to a mixed reality helmet.

articleTitle: Positional Control of 6-DoF Robot Based on an Optimal Inverse Kinematics
abstract: 6-DoF robots are widely used in industry. Positional control of robots is carried out based on solving the inverse kinematics problem using various methods. It is known that for a 6-DoF robot there are many options for solving inverse kinematics. Robot manufacturers are looking to leverage analytics solutions tailored to the robot's configuration. In this case, high calculation speed is ensured, which is necessary for planning trajectories in real time. However, such a solution will not always be optimal. This article explores options for solving inverse kinematics using the KUKA KR6 robot as an example. The forward kinematics are described by the Denavit-Hartenberg method. The inverse kinematics are solved by the iterative method. To assess the effectiveness of the solution, an evaluation indicator is proposed in the form of the sum of increments of the angles of the links. Two examples were considered with initial data from the KUKA KR6 R700 robot. The simulations carried out for these examples found that a variety of solution options correspond to a wide range of the 4–5 score. It was revealed that the analytical solution of inverse kinematics does not correspond to the minimum value of the indicator.

articleTitle: Enhancing Brain Tumor Classification Using Data-Efficient Image Transformer
abstract: Medical image analysis is essential in the diagnosis and treatment of many diseases, including brain tumors. This work investigates the effectiveness of transformer models in the multiclass classification of brain tumor MRI images. We use a combination of three publicly available brain tumor datasets classified into four categories and appropriately modify existing transformer variants, including adjustments to patch size, number of categories, dropout, etc. The results indicate that, due to the condition of insufficient data volume, most transformer variants are still inferior to the benchmark model VGG-16. The DeiT model with knowledge distillation has significantly improved various indices on the test set, verifying its effectiveness in the classification of brain tumor MRI images under limited data. The article supports the application of transformer-based models to medical image analysis. Follow-up work will verify the generalization performance of the model on other datasets and explore methods to reduce the dependence of the transformer on the data, making it more applicable to tasks such as medical images classification.

articleTitle: Development of a Combined Model for Evaluating the Effectiveness of Measures in a Distributed Network and an Algorithm for its Interaction with a Relational Database
abstract: Efficient active-adaptive sectionalizing elements are being introduced in the distribution grids (DN) of the Russian Federation: reclosers and load disconnectors, which contribute to both self-repair of the grid in case of unstable faults and localization of stable faults. In each specific case, the implementation of measures in DNs should take into account their economic feasibility depending on: the amount of power shortages and consumer losses; the location of points of optimal network division affecting the amount of load losses; reliability indicators (RI) of equipment and its cost; acceptable payback periods for modernization and sectionalization of sites. The article is devoted to the solution of an urgent problem - the development of a combined model for assessing the efficiency of measures and sectionalization equipment in DNs equipped with smart metering of electric power (EP) devices. The model combines the advantages of both experimentally statistical and deterministic approaches and a high level of adequacy. The decision criteria are: the values of load losses, under-releasing of EP and damage to consumers, frequency, and duration of power interruptions, ensuring standard voltage levels at the points of EP release. The article also describes the algorithm of interaction of the efficiency model as a module of the analytical complex (AC) of the integrated expert diagnostic system (IEDS) of 10/0.4 kV DC equipment with sections of the relational database (DB). The AC calculation modules and the DB file system are the complexes of the formed IESD (Knowledge Base).

articleTitle: Design Software in Tasks of Algorithmization of Manipulation Robots in Assembly of Parts with a Shaft-Bushing Connection Method
abstract: This article presents developments by its authors: the IndustrialKit library package and the RCWorkspace application based on it. The library allows developers of third-party applications to use the functionality of programming and modeling robotic technological complexes in their products. The object-oriented concept of the package provides opportunities for offline training of manipulation robots in a developed simulation environment, subsequent transfer and launch of programs on real robots, organization of feedback control and obtaining statistical data from industrial equipment - common models of robots and various equipment devices, which is achieved through a unified structure of program modules. The connection of external visual models of production system components - robots, tools and parts - is demonstrated. An example of performing the task of assembling parts with spline joints is also given.

articleTitle: Development and Analysis of Mathematical Algorithms Models and Processes Synchronization Functions in Operating Systems for Embedded Reconfigurable Computing Systems
abstract: The study presented in this article delves into mathematical models pertaining to algorithmic and process synchronization functions within operating systems tailored for embedded reconfigurable computing systems. Furthermore, the article explores the hardware implementation of these algorithms and process synchronization functions. The discussion encompasses an examination of the key merits and drawbacks associated with existing models, along with considerations for potential updates. Included are diagrams illustrating a hardware-implemented reconfigurable system and its operational processes. The practical application of the obtained results is situated within computing systems, emphasizing the significance of productivity and efficiency enhancement. In the conclusion are presented the inferences based on the main results of the research.

articleTitle: Application of Intelligent Decision-Making Support Model in the Processes of Omnichannel Marketing
abstract: The study examines the relationship between the development of marketing as a result of the widespread use of information technology. The results of the analysis of scientific literature using the proposed methodology are given. The scientific significance of the research is revealed, which consists in the development and application of intelligent decision support model. The role of Industry 4.0 technologies in the processes of transition from traditional marketing to digital marketing is analyzed. The natural root causes that influenced the change in buying behavior are considered. On the example of a typical Internet marketing agency the processes of goods promotion on electronic trading platforms in BPMN 2.0 notation were analyzed. As a result, an intelligent decision support model was formed. The applied approaches in the field of artificial intelligence were highlighted. The stages of model implementation were also proposed. Based on the results obtained, the process of goods promotion on marketplaces was modernized.

articleTitle: Patch-Based Convolutional Neural Network for Cerebral Aneurysm Recognition
abstract: Intelligent systems are widely and increasingly used in medicine today. A particularly urgent task is to develop computer-aided diagnosis (CAD) systems, a tool that improves the performance of medical professionals in the context of the constantly increasing amount of medical data to analyze. One of the important components of modern CAD systems is a recognition module that helps identify pathological processes in medical images. This study considers the task of training a convolutional neural network to recognize cerebral vascular aneurysms. It offers a fully convolutional UNet-based architecture; a method of data pre-processing; and a method of seamless prediction, which engages the division of the original image into a set of overlapping image patches. The study explores how the size of image patches may affect the training performance of a neural network. The results of conducted computational experiments, after statistical analysis, allow us to conclude that the patch size is not a determining parameter, since an increased image patch size does not improve recognition accuracy. Upon that, experiments showed substantial growth in recognition accuracy, when a batch of training samples is expanded with all other parameters being fixed.

articleTitle: Combinatorial Explosion Problem of Big Data Analytics by Morphological Approach
abstract: Decision making by extracting the knowledge underlying Big Data is considered. Big Data and morphological synthesis of engineering systems can be interrelated in the context of using Big Data to improve and develop innovative systems. The analysis and use of Big Data can help to identify patterns, trends and relationships between different components of technical systems and optimize their performance. Through the use of Big Data, morphological synthesis of engineering solutions can be more accurate and efficient, contributing to the development of new technologies and innovations in various fields. However, one of the major challenges in morphological systems analysis is the curse of dimensionality or combinatorial explosion. The paper discusses possible approaches to reduce the dimensionality of the problem. In particular, it is shown that the application of clustering and variant selection can reduce the number of analyzed variants and select the best ones. The proposed approach allows to increase the efficiency of search for rational engineering solutions. Unlike AI on neural networks, the solutions based on the morphological approach are transparent and controllable. The approach used can improve the validity and visibility of the information analyzed and increase the automation of processes in design and production.

articleTitle: Defining Fuel-Saving Heating Mode for Billets in Through-Type Furnace Using Statistical Model of External Heat Exchange
abstract: This article suggests a method to determine a fuel-saving mode for the guaranteed heating of billets in a furnace. The bulk temperature of the billet and its movement rate in the furnace were used as input data. The distribution of fuel loads was calculated using the Nelder-Mead direct search technique. The total amount of fuel consumed to heat the billet was used as the target function. The first-order lag was used as the billet heating model. The mathematical model of the thermal mode was implemented as a multiple regression equation. This model accounts for the impact of the adjacent zones and the billet movement rate in the furnace. The authors analyzed the correlations in the obtained statistical mathematical model, which involved the selection of factors that have the most significant impact on the parameter considered. The coefficients of the mathematical model were calculated using the regression analysis based on the least square method. The developed model was validated for practical usage based on experimental data. The authors calculated the fuel-saving mode for the heating of a single billet. The comparison of the calculated and the existing billet heating modes showed that the transition to a fuel-saving mode can help reduce the total fuel consumption to 2%.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Exoskeleton Stability Walking Dynamic Model
abstract: The article describes the problem of human stability research in an industrial exoskeleton. The task of ensuring safe walking and human stability in a robotic exoskeleton is relevant for the development of industry and industrial automation systems. A design scheme of a seven-branched exoskeleton of the lower extremities with controlled hinges is presented, and the equations of kinematics of the connections between the links are described. Special attention is paid to the description of the quasi-static walking mode, in which the projection of the center of mass of the exoskeleton moves along a separate smooth trajectory, which ensures stability at each moment of time. The description of walking modes in conditions of stability and gait modeling for various step parameters are given, numerical characteristics of the step parameters are established. An algorithm for numerical simulation of stable walking in an exoskeleton is proposed, and a promising direction in the field of studying dynamic gait is discussed.

articleTitle: Synthesis of Self-Timed Circuits with Memory
abstract: Self-timed (ST) circuits have a number of advantages over synchronous counterparts. They utilize natural interaction between digital units based on data availability. Combinational ST circuits use redundant coding of information and a two-phase operating discipline, which makes it possible to detect the successful circuit switching completion in each phase. The combinational ST circuit synthesis has been well studied, formalized, and implemented in several existing computer-aided design systems for asynchronous digital units. It is based on dualizing the logical function system in order to convert single information signals into dual-rail signals with a null or unit spacer and supplementing an additional indication subcircuit that detects the completion of ST circuit switching into the current phase. The synthesis of ST circuits with memory is less amenable to formalization. The paper considers the problem of implementing typical ST units with memory, namely latches and flip-flops. It analyzes ST latch and flip-flop implementation features and their interaction with the combinational environment, which requires dual-rail coding of information signals, and offers effective circuit solutions that ensure the adequacy of their behavior in relation to synchronous counterparts.

articleTitle: Dynamic Positioning of Underactuated AUVs Using Visual Servoing
abstract: The problem of the autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs) dynamic positioning (DP) in the horizontal plane (HP) using a monocular video camera is considered. A AUV control is formed from the incoming information about the centroid position of a given object or the centroid of key bottom points. It is assumed that the underactuated AUV can move in the HP under the impact of thrust force and turning moment. A constant underwater current is considered as a perturbing influence. The control system is designed on the basis of image based visual servoing approach relying on the methods of stability theory. Algorithms for controlling the AUV DP in the vicinity of a given point above the seabed which do not require estimation of the direction and velocity of the current are proposed. The results are illustrated by computer modelling.

articleTitle: Problems of Using PLC Technology in Industrial Systems in the Context of Digitalization
abstract: This article updates PLC (Power Line Communication) technologies for industrial systems in the context of digitalization and shows the demand for data transmission systems in PLC networks. To implement a PLC network, it is necessary to connect components of industrial systems via PLC adapters; the advantages of using PLC adapters are presented. Problems when using a PLC network have also been updated. Research has been carried out on data transfer between two PLC adapters in different connection schemes and at different distances. Research has shown that the highest data transfer speed can be achieved in a network connected through an electrical noise filter. Without an electrical noise suppressor (ENS), the transmission speed dropped several times. It was also revealed how the data transfer speed depends on the distance between PLC adapters in for different connection schemes.

articleTitle: Search Procedures Optimization in Digital Twin Data Lakes
abstract: The development of Data Lake technology is observed in many areas of smart manufacturing. Data lakes are used to create digital twins in the fuel and energy complex, energy, and metallurgy. The processes of obtaining new materials are no exception in this development direction of science and technology. In the context of the rapid growth of new data and the accumulation of chemical information obtained in the form of digital models of chemical compounds and materials, new information solutions and tools are in great demand, allowing for the search, analysis and visualization of available diverse data. The research is devoted to the development of methods for organizing known information about the structure and properties of compounds and materials, as well as software components for automating and increasing the productivity of search procedures. The issues of organizing the storage and processing of chemical data are considered, ways to improve the performance of search queries are shown, as well as displaying modifications of file structures in a relational database and in a distributed database based on Hadoop tools. File analysis and parsing highlights various properties of crystalline and molecular structures, organizing them into tree structures (JSON format), convenient for indexing and searching information in Data Lake of the “column family” type, which is a sparse matrix of search attributes. The results of accelerating search procedures for some search examples are presented, showing a significant acceleration in obtaining search query results.

articleTitle: Evaluation and Optimization of Vehicle Cabin Ergonomics Using Virtual Reality
abstract: The article discusses the idea of developing a cabin design complex using virtual reality technology to optimize production, improve ergonomics and comfort of the vehicle. It is planned to create a modifiable “on-the-fly” hardware-software complex for cabin conceptualization, consisting of a set of real cabin elements, a virtual reality helmet for rendering the environment, road and cabin design for the test subject, as well as a special operator program for controlling the driver's condition and changing the configuration of the cabin. The creation of an on-the-fly modifiable hardware and software system will reduce the cost of recreating the model of each new cabin. Various methods of taking information from the human body, such as ECG and EEG, eye movement, level of sleepiness, international standards, and others are proposed. Reviewing and selecting the most relevant metrics will allow for a more accurate determination of driver fatigue levels, and therefore the selection of better vehicle ergonomics.

articleTitle: Evaluating the Use of Support Vector Machine Models for Contact State Identification of Non-Rigid Cylindrical Parts During Robotic Assembly
abstract: The article solves the problem of determining the current contact state (CS) during assembly using the support vector machine (SVM) method when receiving information about the position coordinates by the industrial robot system and forces from a force-torque sensor. The purpose of the work is to create a method for recognizing the contact state when assembling non-rigid cylindrical parts with rigid sleeve as a basis for developing an algorithm for the coupling process. A mathematical model of the problem of recognizing the contact state when coupling non-rigid cylindrical peg-in-hole type parts by a robot retrofitted with a force-torque sensor is presented. In this article, it is proposed to use the SVM method with a data source that is the coordinates of the position from the industrial robot system and the forces from the force-torque sensor to identify the contact state of compatible robot movement tasks. An experimental setup with an ABB IRB-140 industrial robot equipped with a Schunk force-torque sensor is used to evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Conceptual Foundations for Forming a Configuration Management Subsystem of a Telecommunications Network
abstract: Today, changes as a response to internal and external disturbances in the technological process of any system are an important criterion for determining the viability and adaptation of such a system. Since managing modern communication networks is impossible without intelligent subsystems, the requirements for them must be correspondingly high. The key element of the communication device management subsystem is the database with all its internal processes for processing and storing, as well as all tasks and issues related to the current configuration of the communication network. The work presents the result of a phased integration of the CMDB repository as a separate subsystem of the telecommunication network management system. A set of architectures is proposed, according to which it will be possible to mathematically and programmatically realize the development of a universal configuration management subsystem for telecommunications network management systems with high scalability, complex technological solutions, and multi-criteria requirements.

articleTitle: Self-Timed Counter Implementation Basis
abstract: The article researches the problem of self-timed (ST) binary counter implementation. ST circuits demonstrate correct operation over a much wider range of supply voltage and ambient temperature, in contrast to synchronous counterparts. The reason for this is hardware redundancy, two-phase operating discipline and mandatory acknowledging of the switch completion of all circuit cells in each phase of circuit operation. As a result, ST circuits operate stably no matter the cell delays. Due to their simpler indication, serial ST counters have less hardware redundancy than combinational ST circuits. However, they require the specific procedure organization to implement ST preset. The article examines the circuitry basis for the ST counter implementation and proposes a schematic preset realization ensuring its self-timing and optimal hardware complexity.

articleTitle: An Approach to Increasing the Speed of Calculating the Composition of an Aircraft Manufacturing Enterprise Products Using Parallelization of Calculations
abstract: The paper discusses methods for constructing software for constructing a product composition tree for an aircraft manufacturing enterprise, their advantages and disadvantages. Based on an analysis of available implementation schemes, a hypothesis has been put forward about the possibility of increasing the efficiency of solving the problem by using parallelism, cutting off redundancy and bypassing the technical limitations of the available tools. Based on a series of experiments, a methodology for constructing software has been formulated to effectively solve the problem of constructing a product composition tree in aircraft manufacturing conditions. Based on the proposed methodology, a working prototype of the software was developed and comparative tests were carried out, which showed an increase in productivity by several orders of magnitude.

articleTitle: Research of Summarization Methods for Presentation Slides Generation
abstract: Making presentations is a creative process that requires the use of analytical skills to highlight the main thoughts and convey them in a concise and visually pleasing form. In this paper, popular language models were used for summarizing voluminous documents in Russian and compared on prepared datasets such as GusevGazeta, scientcific articles datasets in two languges: russian and english. With the help of SummaRuNNer extraction method, it was possible to achieve better accuracy of summarization of large russian texts' volumes than with other abstract methods under consideration. Proposed FastAPI application architecture for generating presentations. The service parses PDF files, extracts titles and images, creates a summary of the text using artificial intelligence.

articleTitle: Identification of a Person Based on Block Processing of a Signature Image
abstract: The development of computer vision systems stimulates the development of various applications in the field of image recognition. Methods and algorithms for image recognition in document processing systems play a crucial role. There is a lot of research in this direction, and one of the most difficult problems is handwritten text recognition. This includes the tasks of signature identification, which the authors of the paper consider. The article considers the main stages of signature analysis to establish authorship. They are the preprocessing of the signature, representation in a form convenient for applying author identification. A dataset containing sample signatures of various people is used. The described tools became means to develop software for preprocessing images of signatures, extracting characteristics and identifying the author of the signature.

articleTitle: Research and Analysis of Modified Paired Transitions Algorithm Based on Fuzzy Logic in Software Defined Networks of Internet of Things
abstract: The problem of dynamic routing in a software defined networks (SDN) Internet of Things is considered, in which communication links have several quality of service (QoS) parameters. A modified paired transition algorithm based on fuzzy logic for dynamic routing to QoS ensure has been developed. A fuzzy inference system (FIS) to determine the correspondence of a communication link to a certain QoS based on the values of its parameters has been created. The linguistic variables and the base of fuzzy rules of the FIS are described. A visual environment has been developed for the experimental study of algorithms used in SDN based on fuzzy logic. Its main functions and interface are described. An experimental study of the modified paired transition algorithm based on fuzzy logic was carried out. It is shown that changing the QoS parameters of communication links leads to only a slight change in the original tree of optimal routes.

articleTitle: The Approach to Assessing the Correctness of Automated System Endpoint Devices' Parameters Using their Reference Models
abstract: The study examines the problem of assessing the correctness of data provided by endpoint devices in automated systems. It is noted that data can be falsified intentionally by attackers, and therefore the assessment of data correctness and decisions made on its basis should be the part of the enterprise information security system. The main tasks for the described problem are formulated, and an approach to solving them is presented by creating reference models of endpoint devices. A procedure for assessing the correctness of data is proposed, which is depicted as a business process in IDEF0 notation. The main processes of the proposed approach are described in detail. The input and output data necessary for the functioning of the approach are indicated.

articleTitle: Development of Digital Twin Technology for Power Transformer Diagnostics Based on the Partial Discharges Method
abstract: Recently, the partial discharges method has been actively developed for the diagnosis of power transformers. Relatively recently, the partial discharge method began to be used in digital twin technologies. To effectively solve these problems in order for diagnose the insulation of power transformers, it is necessary, using special software and hardware systems, localize partial discharges from various sources and, based on their characteristics, determine the pre-breakdown situation. In order to distinguish partial discharges from other spark discharges, it is necessary to construct so-called amplitude-phase diagrams. At this stage, there are difficulties due to interference, so they usually resort to special reference voltage sources, which, in turn, are difficult to use practically for diagnosing a power transformer. This publication proposes to extract information about the reference signal and construct amplitude-phase diagrams based on the same data sources using a telescopic antenna specially modified for these purposes.

Author Keywords: determination of the insulation state of a power transformer

articleTitle: The Application of Convolutional Neural Networks and Fuzzy Logic in Control and Automation Systems for Recognizing and Assessing the Danger Level of Hot Cracks in the Production of Cast Products
abstract: The use of computer technologies applying combined systems of convolutional neural networks and fuzzy logic in the analysis of casting images for detecting and classifying hot cracks represents an innovative approach in foundry production, possessing significant potential for solving quality and safety issues of products. Trained on large and diverse sets of casting images, these systems are capable of identifying hot cracks, recognizing their unique characteristics such as shape, size, and orientation. This is achieved through targeted study of patterns inherent in hot cracks and their comparison with an extensive database of images. The presence of noise, artifacts, or blurred crack boundaries in images can complicate the task of classification and analysis. Fuzzy logic is employed to allow the system to more flexibly interpret data, assessing the degree of uncertainty and ambivalence in the information.

articleTitle: The Concept of Trust in the Integration of Information Systems
abstract: The integration of information systems is an inevitable reality, because it gives a competitive advantage and allows you to reduce business costs. Information security problems that arise during integration are usually solved by establishing trust. However, the concept of trust itself, as it turned out, has not been studied and formalized, which makes it difficult both to theoretically study this phenomenon and to use it in practice. The purpose of the article is to formalize the concept of trust in information systems on the basis of existing theoretical studies and practical experience. Trust is considered as a measure of security as opposite to risk that is considered as a measure of danger. The functional structure of trust is presented. A statement about the necessary and sufficient condition for the existence of trust in an information system is formulated and proven by the resolution method. The offered concept of trust is equally well applicable to software, hardware, personnel, documents etc.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Price Prediction on Green Building Prices
abstract: This article delves into the intersection of sustainable real estate and cutting-edge technology, exploring the role of machine learning in predicting prices for green buildings. With an increasing global emphasis on eco-friendly practices, green buildings have emerged as a pivotal force in the real estate landscape. The unique features of these structures, from energy-efficient systems to LEED certifications, present challenges to traditional pricing models. Machine learning offers a dynamic solution by harnessing the power of data to predict green building prices accurately. We navigate through the essential steps of data collection, feature engineering, model selection, and continuous learning, revealing how machine learning stands as a transformative force in shaping a more sustainable and economically viable future for real estate. Through this exploration, it becomes clear that the integration of machine learning is not only a technological advancement but a catalyst for the broader adoption of green building practices in the real estate industry.

articleTitle: Practical Implementation of an LLC Converter with Integrated Resonant Circuit Elements
abstract: The article shows the relevance of using converters based on an LLC resonant circuit in power supplies for computing and data storage systems. It is shown that the use of parasitic parameters of a transformer as elements of a resonant circuit makes it possible to reduce the number of separate magnetic elements of the converter. Integration of the inductance of a series resonant circuit into a transformer leads to a change in frequency characteristics. Equals which are given, allow one to calculate the voltage gain of the resonant circuit. The results of prototyping the converter are presented. The design of a transformer is shown. Soft switching of converter transistors with integrated circuit elements is shown.

articleTitle: Exploring the Impact of Parameters on the Effectiveness of the Neural Network Alternate Incremental Learning Algorithm
abstract: This article investigates the influence of various parameters on the Alternate Incremental Learning Algorithm within the context of neural networks. The primary focus is on three prominent factors: the number of neurons in the hidden layer, the choice of activation function, and the distribution range of weight coefficients. An experimental approach was adopted where the number of hidden layer neurons was varied between 5 and 50, thereby providing insights into how network complexity affects learning capacity. The considered activation functions encompass the sigmoid, rectified linear unit, and hyperbolic tangent, each possessing distinct characteristics that impact network convergence and generalization. Weight coefficients were generated across three ranges: -0.1 to 0.1, -0.5 to 0.5, and -1 to 1, to examine their influence on the network's hypothesis space and learning stability. The study utilized synthetic data analogous to smartphone sensor outputs, targeting the future application of activity recognition. The results summarized in three detailed tables provide a comprehensive analysis of each parameter's impact on the effectiveness of the Alternate Incremental Learning Algorithm.

articleTitle: Development of a Query Delay Injection System for the MEC Simulator of the LWMECPS Platform
abstract: In this paper the problem of testing decision making systems for MEC platforms was formulated.
